title: Planning Engineer (
description:
**vConstruct**, a Pune based international construction technology company is seeking a 4D Planning Engineer with strong expertise in 4D Construction Planning, Visual Planning, Construction Sequencing, and Construction Logistics. The Lead Visual Planner will be responsible for leading visual planning deliverables, guiding team members, coordinating with internal and client teams, and developing high-quality simulations, construction logistics plans, and visual communication deliverables for Commercial, Data Center, Healthcare, Hospitality, Advanced Technology, and Higher Education sector projects.

  

**Principal Responsibilities Include:**

**Visual Planning & 4D Simulation**

• Develop, manage, and update 4D construction sequences and animations using SYNCHRO 4D Pro.

• Integrate master schedules (from Primavera P6 or MS Project) with 3D BIM models.

• Create construction phasing, sequencing, and milestone-based simulations to support project planning and execution.

• Generate "what-if" scenario analyses and visual comparisons to evaluate alternative construction approaches.

• Develop visual work plans and 4D simulations that effectively communicate complex construction activities, sequencing strategies, and project constraints to stakeholders, enabling early identification of construction sequencing issues, workspace conflicts, and execution risks.

  

**Construction Logistics Planning**

• Develop site logistics plans, material flow studies, site utilization plans, and temporary works layouts.

• Visualize crane operations, laydown areas, pedestrian pathways, delivery routes, and site access strategies.

• Produce logistics sequencing animations for project pursuits and active projects.

• Identify logistical constraints and propose optimized construction workflows.

  

**BIM & Model Coordination**

• Review BIM models for sequencing, constructability, and visualization readiness.

• Coordinate with BIM, VDC, and design teams to prepare models for visual planning.

• Perform constructability reviews and support risk identification through visual analysis.

• Ensure model quality and data consistency across project deliverables.

  

**Project Delivery & Client Engagement**

• Lead project discussions related to visual planning, logistics planning, and 4D implementation.

• Facilitate planning workshops with project teams, superintendents, trade partners, and clients.

• Translate planning and scheduling information into clear, visually compelling deliverables.

• Present visual planning outcomes and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders.

  

**Team Leadership & Quality**

• Mentor and support Visual Planners and team members on best practices, workflows, and deliverable quality.

• Review project deliverables for accuracy, consistency, and alignment with client requirements.

• Support development of standards, templates, and visual planning methodologies.

• Contribute to capability development and innovation initiatives within the Visual Planning group.

  

**Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

• Drive adoption of emerging technologies in visual planning and construction simulation.

• Explore integration of AI, automation, and production tracking workflows.

• Support development of repeatable solutions that improve efficiency and scalability of visual planning services.

  

**Skills and Qualifications:**

• Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or related field.

• 3 years of experience in VDC, Construction Planning, BIM, or Visual Planning.

• Strong experience with SYNCHRO 4D Pro.

• Strong understanding of construction sequencing, construction means & methods, and project execution planning.

• Experience interpreting CPM schedules and construction documents.

• Experience with project stakeholder coordination and client-facing communication.

  

**Technical Skills**

• SYNCHRO 4D Pro

• SYNCHRO Control & Field

• Primavera P6

• Autodesk Revit

• Navisworks Manage

• Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)

• Power BI

• Microsoft Office Suite

  

**Key Competencies**

• 4D Construction Planning

• Visual Communication

• Construction Sequencing

• Logistics Planning

• Constructability Review

• Client & Stakeholder Management

• Team Mentoring

• Problem Solving

• Innovation & Continuous Improvement

• Presentation & Facilitation Skills

  

**About vConstruct** We are a team of enthusiastic construction engineering and technology experts who are passionate about increasing the predictability of building better products by applying smarter processes while striving for faster delivery. We provide services and solutions to the Construction Industry in the area of Virtual Design and Construction (VDC), Project Controls Management, Accounting and Software Development. On any given day, we make an impact on several large-scale construction projects across the globe through our services and solutions.

Since we started in 2013, we are at a continuous lookout for talent driven by the vision to transform the construction industry by the use of technology.

We are a subsidiary of DPR Construction, a USA based technical builder that specializes in highly complex projects in Healthcare, Life Sciences, Advance Technology, Higher Education and Commercial buildings.

description:
***Ready to scale enterprise Generative AI products from prototype to production?***

**Why join us?**

HSBC Productivity Suite is our AI-powered workspace used by 250,000 colleagues across the bank. We’re now moving beyond conversational generative AI to build intelligent agents and integrations that connect colleagues with trusted enterprise knowledge, services and workflows.

You’ll join a global engineering team solving complex problems at significant scale, with the opportunity to shape how AI is designed, governed and used across HSBC. This is a hands-on technical leadership role with real influence over architecture, engineering standards and product direction.

**The Opportunity**

We’re looking for a senior individual contributor who will provide hands-on technical leadership across one or more engineering pods and mentor engineers in Pune. This is not a people-management role: success will come through engineering expertise, architecture leadership, delivery and influence across teams. The role will own significant integrations, help define the Productivity Suite technical strategy and roadmap, and support adoption in India and neighbouring markets. This is a deeply hands-on role: you’ll be expected to spend more than 50% of your time designing, coding, testing and deploying software

**What you’ll do:**

* Spend more than half your time on hands-on engineering, writing, reviewing and deploying production code for HSBC Productivity Suite.
* Design and build production-grade generative AI capabilities and integrations, working across architecture, code, testing, deployment and ongoing operation.
* Provide technical leadership across engineering pods through direct contribution, setting technical direction and solving the most complex engineering problems.
* Shape technical strategy and roadmaps, translating ambiguous business problems into measurable outcomes and practical engineering plans.
* Improve reusable capabilities, frameworks, tooling and engineering standards, including the effective use of agentic AI across the software development lifecycle.
* Mentor engineers through pairing, design reviews and code reviews, without formal line-management responsibility.
* Lead from the front on production support and incident response, ensuring services meet availability, performance, resilience and scalability expectations.
* Work with product, engineering, business and operations leaders, influencing priorities through evidence and technical expertise.

**What you’ll need to succeed in the role**:

* Deep, hands-on software engineering experience, with a strong record of designing, coding and operating user-facing products at scale.
* Advanced use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to prototype, write, test and review code safely, alongside experience building agents that improve the software development lifecycle.
* Strong Python expertise and practical knowledge of modern engineering practices, including APIs, microservices, databases, containers and continuous integration and delivery, and modern front-end development using React.
* Hands-on experience taking AI, machine learning and generative AI solutions from experimentation through to secure, reliable production use.
* Strong practical knowledge of large language models, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, evaluation, guardrails, observability and responsible AI.
* Experience leading through technical expertise and influence - setting direction, solving complex engineering problems and mentoring others while remaining a hands-on individual contributor.
* Experience designing and operating cloud-based services using platforms such as Google Cloud, Amazon Web Services or Microsoft Azure.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to turn ambiguous business problems into measurable outcomes and practical technical solutions.

**Building HSBC’s AI engineering capability**

This is a chance to shape how enterprise AI engineering is built and scaled across HSBC. You’ll create the platforms, patterns and delivery discipline that help teams move from experimentation to production with confidence. The work spans technology and business outcomes with clear accountability for quality, reliability and measurable value. If you’re ready to help set direction for GenAI at enterprise scale we’d welcome your application.

**Company:**

Marsh

**Description:**
----------------

Marsh is seeking a talented individual to join our IT team as an AI Native Intern. This role is based in Pune. This is a hybrid role with a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

  

**Designation: Engineer**

IT application team is an in-house application development and support team for a suite of applications used by the Insurance Broking & Employee Benefit business

  

**We will count on you to:**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, build, integrate, test, and support high-quality AI-enabled solutions that deliver practical business outcomes.
* Harness AI-powered developer tools – including coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and Gemini – and integrate LLM APIs as active accelerators across your day-to-day development workflow, not as an afterthought.
* Apply prompt design and structured interaction techniques to obtain reliable, contextual outputs from generative AI systems for practical engineering and business use cases.
* Verify and validate AI-assisted outputs for correctness, relevance, logic, security, privacy, performance, and fitness for purpose before they are used in production or decision-making.
* Participate in the full lifecycle of AI-enabled solution delivery, including problem framing, design, integration, testing, deployment, monitoring, and support.
* Document solution assumptions, design decisions, guardrails, validation approach, and technical rationale for AI-enabled features and workflows, and support business process improvement initiatives.
* Learn and apply best practices in software engineering, Agile/Scrum, and DevOps within an AI-augmented team.
* Adapt quickly to a fast-changing AI-enabled project environment, demonstrating resilience and a growth mindset.
  

  

**What you need to have:**

* B.E. / B. Tech degree (Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering discipline).
* Minimum 60% aggregate in Graduation and Post Graduation.
* Will Graduate in 2027 with no active backlogs in any subject.
* Hands-on exposure to at least one modern programming language – Python, JavaScript, Java, C#, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and generative AI concepts, including LLM behavior, prompting, retrieval, evaluation, limitations, and common failure modes.
* Working knowledge of SQL and/or NoSQL databases
Demonstrated practical application of AI in at least one project, prototype, workflow, or use case beyond code generation.  

**What makes you stand out:**

* Learning Agility – you pick up new tools, patterns, and frameworks fast and apply them independently.
* Critical Thinking – you interrogate AI outputs rather than accepting them at face value; you ask "why" and "so what?"
* Adaptability – you thrive in ambiguous, rapidly changing environments where the best practice of today may be outdated by next quarter.
* Analytical Thinking – you break complex problems into structured components and reason from data and evidence.
* Collaboration – you work effectively across engineering, product, and business teams.
* Digital Literacy – you are comfortable navigating new digital tools and ecosystems with minimal handholding.
* Innovation Mindset – you actively explore new ways to do things better, faster, or with greater impact using AI.
* Prompt Engineering – ability to write, refine, and iterate effective prompts for generative AI tools to produce reliable, contextual outputs.
* LLM Foundations – understanding of how generative AI models work, their probabilistic nature, limitations, and failure modes.
* Code Verification & Quality – disciplined practice of reviewing and validating AI-generated code, not just accepting it.
* Security Hygiene – awareness of security risks in AI-assisted development, including prompt injection, data leakage, and compliance.
* Business Context – ability to align AI outputs with real business objectives and assess return on investment.
* Modern Tech Stacks – exposure to API development, front-end frameworks, server-side programming, DevOps tooling.
* Availability – openness to work in a 24x7 shift environment when required.
  

  

**Why join our team:**

* Work at the frontier – you will be part of a team actively integrating AI into real enterprise software, not just experimenting in a sandbox.
* Professional development – we invest in your growth through structured learning, mentoring, and access to Marsh McLennan's global development programmes.
* Inclusive culture – we foster a vibrant, diverse workplace where different perspectives drive better solutions for colleagues, clients, and communities.
* Scale and impact – with operations in 130 countries and 95,000+ colleagues, the systems you contribute to have real global reach.
* Career pathways – AI Native Interns have direct visibility to specialist AI roles, engineering tracks, and cross-functional rotations across the Marsh McLennan enterprise.
  

  

**What is an AI Native Intern?**

An AI Native Intern is an engineering professional who understands how to use AI effectively and responsibly to solve practical business and engineering problems, while applying enterprise guardrails, validation, and human judgment.

  
  

At Marsh, this role sits at the Engineering tier of the AI Agility pyramid: professionals who combine strong software development fundamentals with the cognitive readiness and applied AI skills needed to build, integrate, and critically evaluate AI-powered solutions in a live enterprise environment.

What distinguishes an AI Native Intern is the judgment to know when AI should be used, when it should not, how to validate its outputs, and how to align it to business outcomes, quality, safety, and compliance requirements.

We are looking for individuals who are measurably ready for AI-enabled work today who can translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, scalable, and well-governed solutions, and who possess the learning agility to keep pace as technology continues to evolve.

  
  

**To broaden specific asks:** Document solution assumptions, design decisions, guardrails, validation approach, and technical rationale for AI-enabled features and workflows
  
  
..and support Business process improvement initiatives

  
  

**Additional requirement suggestion for stricter filtering:**  
Demonstrated practical application of AI in at least one project, prototype, workflow, or use case beyond code generation.

  
  

**Optional to strengthen further** :...and who can translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, scalable, and well-governed solutions.

**Company:**
------------

Marsh

**Description:**
----------------

Marsh is seeking a talented individual to join our IT team as an AI Native Intern. This role is based in Pune. This is a hybrid role with a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

  

**Designation: Engineer**

IT application team is an in-house application development and support team for a suite of applications used by the Insurance Broking & Employee Benefit business

  

**We will count on you to:**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, build, integrate, test, and support high-quality AI-enabled solutions that deliver practical business outcomes.
* Harness AI-powered developer tools – including coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and Gemini – and integrate LLM APIs as active accelerators across your day-to-day development workflow, not as an afterthought.
* Apply prompt design and structured interaction techniques to obtain reliable, contextual outputs from generative AI systems for practical engineering and business use cases.
* Verify and validate AI-assisted outputs for correctness, relevance, logic, security, privacy, performance, and fitness for purpose before they are used in production or decision-making.
* Participate in the full lifecycle of AI-enabled solution delivery, including problem framing, design, integration, testing, deployment, monitoring, and support.
* Document solution assumptions, design decisions, guardrails, validation approach, and technical rationale for AI-enabled features and workflows, and support business process improvement initiatives.
* Learn and apply best practices in software engineering, Agile/Scrum, and DevOps within an AI-augmented team.
* Adapt quickly to a fast-changing AI-enabled project environment, demonstrating resilience and a growth mindset.
  

  

**What you need to have:**

* B.E. / B. Tech degree (Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering discipline).
* Minimum 60% aggregate in Graduation and Post Graduation.
* Will Graduate in 2027 with no active backlogs in any subject.
* Hands-on exposure to at least one modern programming language – Python, JavaScript, Java, C#, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and generative AI concepts, including LLM behavior, prompting, retrieval, evaluation, limitations, and common failure modes.
* Working knowledge of SQL and/or NoSQL databases
* Demonstrated practical application of AI in at least one project, prototype, workflow, or use case beyond code generation.

**What makes you stand out:**

* Learning Agility – you pick up new tools, patterns, and frameworks fast and apply them independently.
* Critical Thinking – you interrogate AI outputs rather than accepting them at face value; you ask "why" and "so what?"
* Adaptability – you thrive in ambiguous, rapidly changing environments where the best practice of today may be outdated by next quarter.
* Analytical Thinking – you break complex problems into structured components and reason from data and evidence.
* Collaboration – you work effectively across engineering, product, and business teams.
* Digital Literacy – you are comfortable navigating new digital tools and ecosystems with minimal handholding.
* Innovation Mindset – you actively explore new ways to do things better, faster, or with greater impact using AI.
* Prompt Engineering – ability to write, refine, and iterate effective prompts for generative AI tools to produce reliable, contextual outputs.
* LLM Foundations – understanding of how generative AI models work, their probabilistic nature, limitations, and failure modes.
* Code Verification & Quality – disciplined practice of reviewing and validating AI-generated code, not just accepting it.
* Security Hygiene – awareness of security risks in AI-assisted development, including prompt injection, data leakage, and compliance.
* Business Context – ability to align AI outputs with real business objectives and assess return on investment.
* Modern Tech Stacks – exposure to API development, front-end frameworks, server-side programming, DevOps tooling.
* Availability – openness to work in a 24x7 shift environment when required.
  

  

**Why join our team:**

* Work at the frontier – you will be part of a team actively integrating AI into real enterprise software, not just experimenting in a sandbox.
* Professional development – we invest in your growth through structured learning, mentoring, and access to Marsh McLennan's global development programmes.
* Inclusive culture – we foster a vibrant, diverse workplace where different perspectives drive better solutions for colleagues, clients, and communities.
* Scale and impact – with operations in 130 countries and 95,000+ colleagues, the systems you contribute to have real global reach.
* Career pathways – AI Native Interns have direct visibility to specialist AI roles, engineering tracks, and cross-functional rotations across the Marsh McLennan enterprise.
  

  

**What is an AI Native Intern?**

An AI Native Intern is an engineering professional who understands how to use AI effectively and responsibly to solve practical business and engineering problems, while applying enterprise guardrails, validation, and human judgment.

  
  

At Marsh, this role sits at the Engineering tier of the AI Agility pyramid: professionals who combine strong software development fundamentals with the cognitive readiness and applied AI skills needed to build, integrate, and critically evaluate AI-powered solutions in a live enterprise environment.

What distinguishes an AI Native Intern is the judgment to know when AI should be used, when it should not, how to validate its outputs, and how to align it to business outcomes, quality, safety, and compliance requirements.

We are looking for individuals who are measurably ready for AI-enabled work today who can translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, scalable, and well-governed solutions, and who possess the learning agility to keep pace as technology continues to evolve.

title: Validation Engineer
description:
**Validation Engineer (L3)**

**About Unbox Robotics**

We at Unbox Robotics are revolutionizing warehouses and distribution centers by building the world's most compact, powerful, and flexible mobile robotics systems for the new age of warehousing. Our product is the World's 1st of its kind AI-powered parcel sorting robotic system that gets installed 10X faster, saves 50+% space and improves productivity by more than 3X with 50% fewer robots than that of the competition. Founded in 2019, we are backed by marquee investors and angels. We are looking to add to our team of thinkers, innovators and doers and would love to have you join us at the Pune, India office and build the future of on-demand robotics logistics solutions

**Location:** Pune (On-site / Warehouse + Office)

**Experience:** 4–7 years

**About the Role**

As a Validation Engineer L3, you will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and performance of our robotic systems as they move from development to real-world deployment. You will own system-level validation by designing scalable test frameworks, validating software, firmware, and hardware interactions, and driving test execution on real robotic platforms.

This role requires strong hands-on involvement with hardware, deep collaboration with engineering and integration teams, and the ability to think beyond test execution to improve validation strategies, tools, and infrastructure. You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to identify risks early, validate system behavior under real-world and failure scenarios, and ensure our products meet quality, safety, and certification standards before reaching customers.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and implement robust test frameworks for robotic systems, including direct control and testing of real hardware.
* Troubleshoot system-level issues, perform root cause analysis, and create detailed evaluation and test reports.
* Lead end-to-end test processes and communicate results effectively to relevant stakeholders with proper documentation.
* Define expected results and validation criteria for re-testing across multiple product variants.
* Continuously evaluate and adopt new technologies, tools, and methodologies to improve test coverage, efficiency, and reliability.
* Develop and maintain test infrastructure, including reviewing, modifying, and upgrading existing test tools, frameworks, and protocols.
* Perform software and firmware testing using Python, ROS, and embedded firmware environments.
* Provide technical support to product development teams throughout the development and validation lifecycle.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Work closely with engineering, integration, and field teams to validate and troubleshoot deployed systems.
* Travel to customer sites as required to support system testing, issue resolution, and documentation of real-world deployments.
* Conduct user-based testing, fault-injection testing, and safety validation to ensure system robustness and compliance.

**Requirements:**

* Hands-on experience with motion control systems, material handling systems, or robotic platforms.
* Strong understanding of ROS with basic programming experience in C, C++, or Python.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems such as Git.
* Good knowledge of documentation practices and certification or compliance standards.
* Proficiency in JIRA or equivalent issue and project tracking tools.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience working in a fast-paced, Agile or Scrum-based development environment.

**We Value:**

Constant learner to become a Subject Matter Expert

Proven record in start-up environment working with innovations

Exposure to a high paced working environment

Ability to conduct detailed procedures in a time-constrained environment

description:
Support Lead

Pune, Maharashtra

**Job Summary**
---------------

**Job Title**

**Security Testing & Vulnerability Assessment Engineer (VAPT) – Cloud & AI Security**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a highly skilled **Security Testing & Vulnerability Assessment Engineer** with expertise in **Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), OWASP Security Testing, Security Compliance, Vulnerability Management, AI Security Testing, and Cloud Security Assessments** . The ideal candidate will be responsible for identifying, assessing, and mitigating security vulnerabilities across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, APIs, infrastructure, and AI/GenAI solutions.

The role requires hands-on experience in conducting comprehensive security assessments, penetration testing, cloud security reviews, and compliance validation activities. The candidate will work closely with development, DevOps, cloud, AI/ML, and security teams to ensure secure software delivery and maintain a strong organizational security posture.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT)**

* Perform vulnerability assessments and penetration testing for web applications, APIs, mobile applications, cloud environments, and enterprise systems.
* Identify security weaknesses and validate exploitability through controlled testing methodologies.
* Conduct black-box, gray-box, and white-box security assessments.
* Execute internal and external network penetration testing exercises.
* Document findings and provide detailed remediation recommendations.

**Application Security Testing**

* Conduct secure code reviews and application security assessments.
* Perform Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) and Static Application Security Testing (SAST).
* Validate application security controls and authentication mechanisms.
* Assess session management, authorization, encryption, and input validation controls.
* Ensure adherence to secure coding practices and industry standards.

**OWASP Security Validation**

* Evaluate applications against OWASP Top 10 security risks.
* Identify vulnerabilities such as:
* + Broken Access Control
  + Injection Attacks
  + Security Misconfigurations
  + Cryptographic Failures
  + Authentication Weaknesses
  + Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
  + Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
  + Vulnerable Components
* Conduct security reviews during development and pre-production releases.
* Support secure SDLC initiatives and security-by-design implementations.

**Cloud Security Assessment**

* Perform security assessments of cloud-native applications and infrastructure.
* Evaluate cloud security configurations across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Review IAM policies, network security controls, storage configurations, and encryption standards.
* Conduct cloud security posture assessments and identify misconfigurations.
* Assess container, Kubernetes, and microservices security implementations.

**AI & GenAI Security Testing**

* Conduct security testing of AI/ML and Generative AI applications.
* Assess AI systems for risks related to:
* + Prompt Injection
  + Data Poisoning
  + Model Manipulation
  + Data Leakage
  + Adversarial Attacks
  + Unauthorized Access
* Validate security controls for RAG architectures, vector databases, and LLM integrations.
* Evaluate AI governance and responsible AI security requirements.
* Develop AI-specific threat models and test scenarios.

**Vulnerability Management**

* Manage enterprise vulnerability assessment programs.
* Analyze scan results and prioritize remediation activities based on risk.
* Track vulnerabilities through closure using governance processes.
* Establish vulnerability reporting dashboards and KPIs.
* Coordinate with application and infrastructure teams for remediation planning.

**Security Compliance & Governance**

* Support compliance assessments and audits.
* Ensure security controls align with organizational security standards.
* Assist with regulatory and compliance reviews.
* Prepare evidence and documentation required for audits.
* Participate in security governance reviews and risk assessments.

**Security Reporting & Risk Analysis**

* Generate VAPT reports with executive summaries and technical findings.
* Present security risks and remediation strategies to stakeholders.
* Conduct threat assessments and risk analysis activities.
* Develop security metrics and reporting mechanisms.
* Support management with compliance and security posture updates.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Technical Skills Required**

**VAPT & Security Testing**

* Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT)
* Web Application Security Testing
* Mobile Application Security Testing
* API Security Testing
* Network Penetration Testing
* Infrastructure Security Assessment

**Application Security**

* Secure Code Review
* SAST & DAST
* Threat Modeling
* Secure SDLC
* Security-by-Design
* DevSecOps Practices

**OWASP & Security Standards**

* OWASP Top 10
* OWASP API Security Top 10
* CWE/SANS Top 25
* MITRE ATT&CK Framework
* Security Control Validation

**Cloud Security**

* Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* AWS Security
* Azure Security
* Kubernetes Security
* Container Security
* Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM)
* Identity & Access Management (IAM)

**AI Security**

* AI/ML Security Testing
* Generative AI Security
* LLM Security Assessment
* AI Threat Modeling
* Prompt Security Validation
* AI Governance Controls
* RAG Security Testing

**Vulnerability Management Tools**

* Nessus
* Qualys
* Rapid7 InsightVM
* OpenVAS
* Burp Suite
* OWASP ZAP
* Nmap

Metasploit

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Security, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing.
* Strong understanding of application security and secure development practices.
* Experience performing cloud security assessments and reviews.
* Hands-on expertise in OWASP Top 10 testing methodologies.
* Knowledge of AI/GenAI security principles and emerging threats.
* Experience working with stakeholder teams to drive remediation activities.

**Preferred Certifications**

* CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker)
* OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)
* OSWE (Offensive Security Web Expert)
* CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
* CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional)
* CompTIA Security+
* Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer
* GIAC Penetration Tester (GPEN)
* Certified Red Team Professional (CRTP)

**Key Competencies**

* Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing
* Security Risk Analysis
* Ethical Hacking
* Cloud Security Assessment
* Application Security Testing
* AI Security Validation
* Compliance Awareness
* Security Governance
* Incident Investigation
* Problem Solving
* Analytical Thinking
* Stakeholder Communication

**Ideal Role Designation**

* Security Testing Engineer
* VAPT Engineer
* Penetration Tester
* Application Security Engineer
* Cloud Security Assessment Specialist
* AI Security Testing Engineer
* Senior Cyber Security Consultant

We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026.

**About Position:**

We are seeking an experienced UEM Support Specialist to provide Level 2 support for enterprise mobility solutions across Android and iOS environments. The role is responsible for troubleshooting device enrollment, application deployment, compliance, configuration, and device management issues within VMware Workspace ONE UEM. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in mobile device management, Android Enterprise, Apple device enrollment models, and Workspace ONE administration, while delivering exceptional support to end users and business stakeholders.

* **Role: Workspace ONE UEM Mobile Support Engineer**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Provide Level 2 technical support for Android and iOS/iPadOS devices managed through Workspace ONE UEM.
* Troubleshoot device enrollment and registration issues, including initial enrollment failures and re-enrollment challenges.
* Support both corporate-owned and personally owned mobile device enrollment and management scenarios.
* Investigate and resolve Android Enterprise enrollment, configuration, and device management issues.
* Troubleshoot Apple iOS/iPadOS enrollment, compliance, and device management challenges.
* Analyze issues related to Workspace ONE Intelligent Hub and managed device services.
* Review and resolve problems involving device profiles, configuration deployment, and policy enforcement.
* Monitor device compliance status and validate compliance policy implementation.
* Troubleshoot managed application installation, deployment, update, and removal failures.
* Investigate device synchronization, check-in issues, and mobile connectivity challenges.
* Support user and device assignment activities across Workspace ONE environments.
* Troubleshoot authentication and access-related issues during enrollment processes.
* Execute and validate device management commands and administrative actions.
* Perform log analysis and collect diagnostic information for advanced troubleshooting and escalation activities.
* Identify root causes of issues related to devices, user accounts, enrollment configurations, applications, network services, or Workspace ONE platform configurations.
* Document troubleshooting activities, findings, resolutions, and recommendations in ticketing systems.
* Escalate complex platform, infrastructure, and configuration-related issues to L3 engineering teams with complete diagnostic evidence.
* Follow established operational procedures, SLA commitments, and support processes.
* Communicate effectively with end users, customers, and technical teams throughout the support lifecycle.
* Contribute to knowledge management initiatives by creating and updating troubleshooting documentation.

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 8–12 years of experience in Enterprise Mobility Management (EMM), Unified Endpoint Management (UEM), Mobile Device Management (MDM), or endpoint support environments.
* Strong hands-on experience supporting Android Enterprise and Apple iOS/iPadOS devices within Workspace ONE UEM.
* Experience managing both corporate-owned and personally owned (BYOD) mobile devices.
* Strong understanding of Android Enterprise enrollment and management models, including Work Profile, Corporate-Owned Devices, Fully Managed Devices, Corporate-Owned Devices with Work Profile (COPE).
* Experience supporting Apple device management scenarios, including User-Initiated Enrollment, Corporate-Owned Supervised Devices, Automated Device Enrollment (ADE).
* Proficiency using the Workspace ONE UEM administrative console for day-to-day support activities.
* Experience reviewing device and user records, enrollment status, compliance status, profiles, applications, and device event logs.
* Strong understanding of Workspace ONE Intelligent Hub functionality and troubleshooting.
* Ability to differentiate between issues resolvable through standard L2 support and those requiring escalation.
* Knowledge of mobile security, compliance policies, and endpoint management best practices.
* Experience with incident management, service request fulfillment, and SLA-driven support models.
* Familiarity with ticketing systems and IT service management processes.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical users.
* Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

title: Technical Architect_Java
description:
We’re looking for a **Technical Architect** to join our Core engineering team in Noida & Pune.

Working at Taazaa involves engaging with cutting-edge technology and innovative software solutions in a collaborative environment. We emphasize on continuous professional growth, offering workshops and training. Our employees often interact with clients to tailor solutions to business needs, working on diverse projects across industries. We promote work-life balance with flexible hours and remote options, fostering a supportive and inclusive culture. Competitive salaries, health benefits, and various perks further enhance the work experience.

Looking ahead, we aim to expand our technological capabilities and market reach, investing in advanced technologies and expanding our service offerings. We plan to deepen our expertise in AI and machine learning, enhance our cloud services, and continue fostering a culture of innovation and excellence. Taazaa is committed to staying at the forefront of technology trends, ensuring it delivers impactful and transformative solutions for its clients.

We are seeking a **Java Technical Architect** who owns the end-to-end architecture of cloud-native, multi-tenant SaaS products. You will bring deep hands-on expertise in Java (8 through 17/21), Spring Boot, microservices, event-driven systems and AWS, combined with the judgment to make and defend architectural trade-offs.

This is a hands-on architecture role. You will define target architectures, set engineering standards, review critical code, and guide multiple teams and Technical Leads. You will also act as a trusted technical advisor to clients, translating business goals into scalable, secure and cost-effective solutions

**What you’ll do:**

**Architecture & Solution Design**

* + Define and own the end-to-end architecture for enterprise, cloud-native SaaS products, from solution vision to deployment topology.
  + Design multi-tenant architectures, including tenant isolation, data partitioning, tenant-aware security and per-tenant configuration.
  + Decompose domains using Domain Driven Design (DDD) and define microservice boundaries, APIs and data ownership.
  + Design event-driven and reactive systems using Kafka, CQRS, event sourcing and Saga patterns where appropriate.
  + Define non-functional requirements (scalability, availability, performance, security, observability, cost) and design to meet them.
  + Architect AWS solutions using services such as EKS, S3, Cognito, KMS, RDS, SQS/SNS, API Gateway and Lambda.
  + Evaluate options and present multiple architectural approaches with clear trade-offs, then document decisions as Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
  + Lead modernization of legacy monoliths to microservices and cloud-native platforms.
  + Research emerging technologies, including AI/ML and GenAI integrations, and build proofs of concept to validate them.

**Technical Leadership & Governance**

* + Set coding standards, reference architectures, reusable frameworks and engineering best practices across teams.
  + Review designs and critical code through Git pull requests, ensuring quality, security and performance.
  + Mentor Technical Leads and senior engineers, and raise the overall architecture maturity of the team.
  + Define API strategy and standards for REST, gRPC and GraphQL services, including versioning and contracts.
  + Drive security by design: authentication and authorization (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), encryption, secrets management and OWASP compliance.
  + Establish observability standards for logging, metrics, distributed tracing and alerting.
  + Guide CI/CD, DevOps and Infrastructure as Code practices, and own performance and load-testing strategy.
  + Troubleshoot complex production issues and lead root-cause analysis for critical incidents.

**Collaboration & Delivery**

* + Engage with clients and stakeholders in pre-sales and discovery to shape solutions, estimates and technical proposals.
  + Conduct requirement, feasibility and impact analysis for new features and change requests.
  + Coordinate architecture and dependencies across onsite, offshore and external teams.
  + Work with product owners and delivery managers to align technical roadmaps with business priorities.
  + Participate in scrum ceremonies and support delivery teams through the full project lifecycle, including warranty support.

**Your Qualifications**

**Experience**

* + Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering or a related field.
  + 12–16 years of software development experience in Java, with at least 4 years in an architect or solution architect role.
  + Proven record of architecting and delivering cloud-native, multi-tenant SaaS products at enterprise scale.
  + Experience leading multiple teams and Technical Leads across concurrent projects.

**Technical Skills**

* + Expert in Java 8 and modern Java (11/17/21), including concurrency, JVM internals and performance tuning.
  + Deep expertise in Spring, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud (Config, Gateway, Discovery), Spring Security and Spring WebFlux.
  + Strong command of microservices architecture, DDD, CQRS, event sourcing, and resilience patterns (circuit breaker, retry, bulkhead).
  + Mastery of design patterns, including GoF, J2EE, enterprise integration and cloud design patterns.
  + Hands-on AWS experience is a must, including EKS, S3, Cognito, KMS, RDS, IAM and networking (VPC). AWS Solutions Architect certification is a strong plus.
  + Proven experience designing multi-tenancy (database-per-tenant, schema-per-tenant and shared-schema models).
  + Strong SQL and data modeling with RDBMS such as PostgreSQL, Oracle and MySQL; experience with NoSQL such as MongoDB, Cassandra or DynamoDB.
  + Experience with caching (Redis, Hazelcast) and search (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch).
  + Skilled in ORM and data access with Hibernate, JPA, MyBatis/iBatis and JDBC.
  + Experience with messaging and streaming platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, IBM MQ or JMS.
  + Proficient in designing and consuming REST, gRPC and GraphQL APIs.
  + Containerization and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes; Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or CloudFormation.
  + CI/CD with Jenkins, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI; build tools Maven and Gradle; version control with Git.
  + Testing practices including TDD, JUnit, Mockito, contract testing, and performance testing with JMeter or Gatling.
  + Observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry or Datadog.
  + Working knowledge of application security, OAuth2/OIDC, and compliance needs such as SOC 2, GDPR or HIPAA.
  + Hands on experience with AI Productivity tools such as Chat GPT, Copilot, Gemini, Claude.
  + Experience with Spring AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and implementing observability standards using OpenTelemetry (OTel) for distributed tracing, metrics, and logging in AI-enabled microservices.

**Good to Have**

* + Experience with Azure, GCP or PCF in addition to AWS.
  + Exposure to integrating AI/ML or LLM-based services into enterprise applications.
  + Experience with serverless architectures and cost optimization (FinOps) on cloud.
  + Familiarity with front-end architectures (React or Angular) for full-stack solution design.

**Behavioral:**

* + Here are five essential behavioral skills a Technical Lead should possess:
  + **Effective Communication:** Clearly and concisely convey ideas, requirements, and feedback to team members, stakeholders, and clients, fostering an environment of open dialogue and mutual understanding.
  + **Leadership and Mentorship**: Inspire and guide the development team, providing support and encouragement, while promoting a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  + **Problem-Solving Attitude:** Approach challenges with a proactive mindset, quickly identifying issues and developing innovative solutions to overcome obstacles.
  + **Collaboration and Teamwork:** Work well within a team, encouraging collaboration and valuing diverse perspectives to achieve common goals and deliver high-quality results.
  + **Adaptability and Flexibility:** Stay adaptable in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, effectively managing changing priorities and requirements while maintaining focus on project objectives.

**What you’ll get in return:**

Joining Taazaa Tech means thriving in a dynamic, innovative environment with competitive compensation and performance-based incentives. You'll have ample opportunities for professional growth through workshops and certifications, while enjoying a flexible work-life balance with remote options. Our collaborative culture fosters creativity and exposes you to diverse projects across various industries. We offer clear career advancement pathways, comprehensive health benefits, and perks like team-building activities.

**Who we are:**

Taazaa Tech is a kaleidoscope of innovation, where every idea is a brushstroke on the canvas of tomorrow. It's a symphony of talent, where creativity dances with technology to orchestrate solutions beyond imagination. In this vibrant ecosystem, challenges are sparks igniting the flames of innovation, propelling us towards new horizons.

**Welcome to Taazaa, where we sculpt the future with passion, purpose, and boundless creativity.**

title: AI Architect
description:
Job Description

**Designation:** AI Architect — Digital Publishing

**Office Location:** Pune

**Role overview**

We're looking for an AI Architect having more than 12 years of experience to lead the design of AI-assisted and AI-native solutions across our digital platforms. Architect will turn open-ended problems into clear architectures, working prototypes, and credible estimates — quickly — while owning the risk, security, and governance that come with putting AI into content- and IP-heavy products. It's a hands-on, high-influence role that sits between engineering, product, and client-facing teams.

Responsibilities

  
  

**Solutioning & architecture**

* Translate ambiguous business problems and RFPs into target architectures, trade-off analyses, and reference designs for AI-enabled publishing and learning products.
* Pick the right pattern for each problem — prompt/workflow, RAG, fine-tuning, agents/MCP, or classic ML — and justify build-vs-buy and model choices.
* Rapid estimation & enablement
* Produce fast, defensible effort estimates, delivery approaches, and team shapes for proposals and new initiatives.
* Support pre-sales and client conversations with architecture walkthroughs pitched anywhere from engineer to C-suite.

  

**Hands-on AI build & POCs**

* Stand up proofs of concept and reference implementations that de-risk the hard parts before full delivery commits.
* Define evaluation harnesses, guardrails, and acceptance criteria so AI features ship with measurable quality.

  

**Standards, reuse & mentoring**

* Establish reusable accelerators, patterns, and an AI engineering playbook across teams.
* Mentor engineers on AI-assisted development and raise the bar on quality, security, and cost awareness.

  

**AI-native & AI-assisted development**

We mean two different things here, and we expect both.

AI-assisted development — you use AI across the SDLC and lift team velocity with it. You're fluent with AI coding assistants and agentic developer workflows, you prompt and review their output critically, and you know where they genuinely help versus where they create rework or risk.

AI-native development — you design systems where LLMs, retrieval, and agents are first-class components, not bolt-ons. That spans orchestration and tool use (including MCP), retrieval and grounding, evaluation and observability, guardrails, prompt and context management, and the cost and latency engineering these systems need to survive production.

  
  

**Technology stack**

You'll architect and build across our core stack, so hands-on fluency in most of these is expected:

* Backend: .NET, Python/Java
* Frontend & full-stack: TypeScript/JavaScript and modern full-stack development
* Cloud: Azure-based cloud development and services, Cloud Native development
* Deep experience with cloud ecosystems like Amazon Web Services (AWS) (Amazon SageMaker), Microsoft Azure (Azure ML), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (Google Vertex AI).
* Familiarity with MLOps and orchestration tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Weights & Biases.

  

**Responsible AI**

You treat AI as a capability to be governed, not just adopted.

Risk & mitigation — you can name and design around the failure modes of AI usage: hallucination and grounding failure, IP and content leakage, data governance and privacy, evaluation gaps, runaway cost and latency, and model or vendor lock-in. You build in human-in-the-loop checkpoints, evals, and fallbacks rather than trusting the model to behave.

Security — you understand the security surface that AI and agents introduce, and how it differs from traditional app security: prompt injection (direct and indirect), retrieval that authorizes before it retrieves rather than after, agent and tool permissioning, MCP scopes and confused-deputy risks, tenant isolation, and audit trails of what the model saw, decided, and did.

In a publishing context you also think about content and IP exposure — what a legitimate account, automated user, or agent can extract from the platform, and how that extraction would be detected and traced.

  
  

**What you bring**

* 12+ years in software engineering and architecture, including 4+ years designing or delivering LLM/GenAI solutions in production (tune the years to your seniority bar).
* Strong grounding in cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), modern application and data architecture, and API/integration design.
* Practical depth in several of: RAG and vector search, orchestration/agent frameworks, prompt and context engineering, evaluation tooling, and MLOps/LLMOps.
* Security fundamentals for web and AI systems (authentication/authorization, data protection, secure SDLC) plus a working command of AI-specific threats.
* A track record of estimating, scoping, and sequencing delivery, and of communicating clearly with both engineers and executives.
* Comfortable being hands-on in code and prototypes, not only on slides.
* Digital publishing or eLearning domain familiarity is a strong plus: content platforms and headless CMS, SCORM/xAPI, DRM and content protection, metadata, rights, and accessibility.

  

**Bonus points**

* Experience with MCP, multi-agent systems, or agent evaluation and safety tooling.
* Publishing and learning standards: EPUB, ONIX, SCORM/xAPI, QTI, IMS/LTI.
* Relevant cloud or AI certifications, and recognized security credentials.
* Open-source contributions, writing, or speaking on applied AI or AI security.

description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognised across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping market leaders transform their industries.

**About Position:**

We are seeking a highly skilled Automation Test Engineer with strong expertise in Selenium, Python, API Testing, and Test Automation Framework Development. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of enterprise applications through robust automation testing strategies and best practices. You will work closely with developers, product owners, business analysts, and QA teams to design, develop, and execute automated testing solutions that improve software quality and accelerate delivery cycles. This role provides an opportunity to work with modern technologies in an Agile environment while contributing to the organization's automation testing strategy.

* **Role: Senior Automation Test Engineer**

**What You'll Do:**

* Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, developers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and define test strategies.

* Execute automated test suites and analyze results to identify defects, bottlenecks, and quality risks.

* Validate backend data through SQL queries and database testing activities.

* Support test execution in CI/CD pipelines and DevOps-enabled environments.
* Perform root cause analysis on identified defects and testing issues.
* Prepare test reports, execution summaries, quality metrics, and automation dashboards.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes, frameworks, and automation standards.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, reviews, stand-ups, and retrospectives.
* Support production validation and release verification activities when required.

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 5 to 8 years of experience in Automation Testing and Quality Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with Selenium WebDriver.
* Proven experience developing and maintaining enterprise-scale automation frameworks.
* Proficiency in Python for test automation.
* Experience in Playwright or Selenium-based automation implementations.
* Proficiency in Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript for automation development.
* Strong experience in UI Testing, API Testing, Integration Testing, Regression Testing, End-to-End Testing.

* Experience creating robust test plans, test cases, and validation strategies.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates.
* Hands-on experience integrating automated tests within DevOps environments.

* Experience working with Agile and Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Strong understanding of software testing principles, QA methodologies, and automation best practices.
* Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.

* Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical teams.

title: Senior Associate- Manual+Automation QA
description:
Job Description

**Job purpose**

Seeking a Manual & Automation QA Engineer with strong Capital Markets and Fixed Income expertise to drive functional, integration, end-to-end, and data quality testing across trading, post-trade, investment management, and data platforms. The role is responsible for ensuring application quality, data accuracy, business rule compliance, and regulatory adherence through manual testing, source-to-target validation, reconciliation, and automation-led regression testing. The ideal candidate will leverage Python/SQL-based automation frameworks, validate complex fixed-income and post-trade workflows, and collaborate closely with business and engineering teams to deliver high-quality, reliable solutions across legacy and modern technology environments.

**Key responsibilities**

* Perform functional, system, integration, and end-to-end testing across fixed income applications

* Validate complete trade lifecycle events across asset classes including trade capture, order management, execution, confirmation, clearing, settlement, corporate actions, and reporting.

* Perform testing of derivative products and workflows including Options, Swaps, Futures, and Forwards.

* Validate business workflows covering bonds, treasuries, corporate debt, and other fixed income instruments

* Verify trade booking, valuations, cashflows, margin processing, lifecycle events, and settlement workflows across asset classes.

* Create, execute, and maintain comprehensive test cases, test scenarios, and regression test suites

* Perform requirement analysis and ensure test coverage aligned with business and regulatory requirements

* Collaborate with business analysts, traders, product owners, and development teams to validate business functionality

* Support testing across legacy platforms and modern cloud-based applications

* Perform source-to-target data validation across legacy and modern systems, including SQL Server and cloud-based data environments.

* Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, duplication handling, referential integrity, schema structures, metadata, lineage, and business-rule conformance.

* Build and maintain automation-first regression testing frameworks using Python, PySpark, SQL, and reusable validation utilities.

* Execute field-level, dataset-level, transformation-level, and aggregate-level data checks across source, staging, warehouse, data lake, and downstream systems.

* Validate ETL/ELT pipelines, post-trade data flows, stored procedures, batch jobs, and cloud-based execution workflows.

* Design reusable test cases, validation scenarios, reconciliation checks, automated scripts, and regression packs for repeatable data-quality assurance.

* Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries and stored procedures across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar platforms.

* Translate business rules, stored procedure logic, and post-trade process flows into automated validation scripts and assertions.

* Build Python-based utilities, APIs, CLI tools, and reusable frameworks to support data validation, orchestration, API integrations, and reporting workflows.

* Integrate regression tests, data validation checks, SQL deployables, and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, or equivalent tools.

* Automate execution of AutoSys jobs, batch processes, stored procedures, and validation scripts across development, UAT, and production environments.

* Work with engineering teams to embed data quality controls into pipelines, releases, and operational workflows.

* Identify data anomalies, schema mismatches, duplicate records, null-handling issues, transformation failures, reconciliation breaks, and integrity violations.

* Log defects with clear evidence, impact analysis, root-cause observations, and business context.

* Support capital markets and post-trade validation across allocations, clearing, settlement, confirmations, reconciliations, market data, reference data, and downstream reporting.

**Key competencies**

* Strong experience in Manual Testing methodologies and QA best practices

* Solid understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)

* Strong experience in test case design, defect management, and regression testing

* Deep domain knowledge of Capital Markets with expertise in Fixed Income products and workflows

* Experience validating trade lifecycle processes including order management, execution, allocations, settlements, and reporting

* Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate test case generation, requirement analysis, defect investigation, test documentation, and test data preparation

* Hands-on experience in Data QA, Data Engineering QA, or Python-based automation roles.

* Good Python skills for data validation, automation framework development, regression testing, and pipeline verification.

* Working knowledge of PySpark for validating large-scale data pipelines and distributed datasets.

* Good SQL skills for source-to-target validation, reconciliation, complex queries, stored procedures, schema checks, and defect analysis.

* Experience in data QA, ETL/ELT testing, data pipeline testing, and regression testing across legacy and modern platforms.

* Proven experience building automation-first regression frameworks, reusable validation scripts, test cases, and data verification utilities.

* Strong understanding of data quality dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, referential integrity, and business-rule conformance.

* Experience validating metadata, schema structures, data types, constraints, lineage, transformation logic, and downstream outputs.

* Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitLab, with the ability to integrate automated tests and quality gates into deployment pipelines.

* Familiarity with batch orchestration tools such as AutoSys, Control-M, or Airflow.

* Good analytical skills to understand post-trade, financial, market data, or reference data and translate them into repeatable validation scenarios.

* Experience with JIRA, XRay, agile delivery practices, defect management, and QA process governance.

* Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot to accelerate test case generation, SQL development, data validation, defect analysis, documentation, and test data creation.

* Strong communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to test management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA, ALM, or similar tools

* Experience with market data, reference data, pricing, and security master validation

* Understanding of fixed income analytics including yields, durations, coupon calculations, and bond pricing

concepts

* Experience validating interfaces between front-office, middle-office, and back-office systems

* Knowledge of regulatory reporting and compliance processes relevant to capital markets environments

* Exposure to SQL for data validation and support of backend testing activities

title: Staff Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
This role is based in Pune. This location works on a hybrid model, 2-3 days in the office. You will be required to interview in person.

  

**About SailPoint:**

SailPoint is defining the next era of identity security. Our unified, AI-powered platform seamlessly secures both the Human Fabric of your workforce and the Agentic Fabric of AI and non-human identities, completely eliminating organizational blind spots.

Built on core principles like zero-standing privilege and contextualized risk, our platform transforms identity from a vulnerability into a strategic business advantage. Today, we are trusted by some of the largest, most complex organizations in the world to deliver intelligent, autonomous identity security at scale.

  

**About the Role:**

Our Human Fabric Team is looking for a well-rounded **Staff Software Development Engineer in Test** with a proven record of ensuring the delivery of scalable microservice based solutions to enterprise clients. Capable of driving several projects to completion from a QA perspective. A skilled technician that can also serve as a mentor to the team. A visionary that delivers recommendations on how to evolve testing best practices within the organization that solve today’s problems with the future direction of product testing in mind.

  

**About the Team:**

You will join our globally disperse engineering team but be supported by engineers based in Pune. We are a results-driven, highly collaborative group passionate about delivering high-impact identity security solutions. Our team develops and tests enterprise products built on a mature, cloud-native, event-driven microservices architecture hosted in AWS. We value individual ownership, teamwork, continuous learning, and technical craftsmanship, providing an environment where your contributions directly shape our product quality.

  

**Roadmap for Success:**

  

* 30 days: Complete engineering onboarding, set up your local development and testing environments, and build an understanding of SailPoint's product capabilities and microservices architecture. Shadow team members on existing testing workflows and execute initial test cases within sprint cycles.
* 60 days: Take ownership of test planning and validation for assigned feature areas. Develop detailed manual and automated test cases covering functional, regression, and integration scenarios, integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines.

* 90 days: Independently drive testing activities across complex microservices features. Partner proactively with development teams to reproduce and triage defects, analyze test metrics, and ensure comprehensive test coverage across supported operating systems and database environments.

* 6 months: Champion automated testing best practices, reduce test execution cycle times, and optimize test harness reliability. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Management and Engineering leadership to align testing strategy with product delivery goals.

1 year: Serve as a subject matter expert for product test engineering and automation frameworks. Drive continuous quality improvements, establish testing standards for new platform capabilities, and mentor team members across the organization.  

  

**Requirements:**

* Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience

* 8+ years of professional experience in testing enterprise software, preferably in a Java/J2EE environment

* Proven ability to develop and maintain comprehensive test cases and test harnesses, both manual and automated

* Hands-on experience with one or more automated UI testing frameworks (such as Selenium, Cypress, Karate or equivalent)

* Strong working knowledge of SQL and experience with one or more relational database platforms (such as SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, DB2, or PostgreSQL)

* Hands-on experience configuring test environments, including application servers (such as Tomcat, WebLogic, WebSphere, or JBoss) across Windows Server and Linux/Unix operating systems

* Familiarity with JavaScript, XML, and Java

* Proven ability to work collaboratively with software development engineers for defect reproduction and resolution

Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong analytical and diagnostic abilities  

  

**AI-assisted engineering:**

Our engineers are expected to use AI development tools as a core part of their daily workflow, not as a novelty. We expect you to use these tools to accelerate delivery, expand your scope, and raise the quality bar, while applying strong engineering judgment to review, validate, and own everything that ships under your name. Comfort with prompting, agentic workflows, and human-in-the-loop review of AI-generated code is a baseline expectation for this role.

  

**AI related Technology:**

* Cursor, Claude Code

* Python-based AI/ML frameworks and libraries such as scikit-learn, pandas, and numpy

* Deep Learning Frameworks such as PyTorch

LLMs and Foundation Models in Bedrock, VertexAI, or similar  

  

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience with LDAP, Active Directory, or other enterprise identity systems

* Experience testing cloud-native applications hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS)

Familiarity with Agile/Scrum software development methodologies  

  

**About SailPoint India and our Benefits:**

  

Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals. Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 2-3 days a week (unless otherwise specified).

  

We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits:

* Competitive Compensation

* Paid Leave: Competitive vacation policies alongside paid company holidays to help you recharge.

* Comprehensive Healthcare: Premium medical, dental, and vision insurance options

* Career Growth Opportunities

* Plus so much more!

SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.

Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. Contact applicationassistance@sailpoint.com or mail to 11120 Four Points Dr, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78726, to discuss reasonable accommodations. NOTE: Any unsolicited resumes sent by candidates or agencies to this email will not be considered for current openings at SailPoint.

title: Team Lead - Product Improvements
description:
Req ID: 5189

Job Type: Hybrid

Location: Pune, MH, IN

  

**Main responsibilities and tasks:**

Burckhardt Compression is seeking a technically strong and innovative engineering leader to drive product improvement initiatives across reciprocating compressor products and related rotating equipment. The role will be responsible for identifying, conceptualizing, prioritizing, and executing engineering improvements that enhance product performance, reliability, manufacturability, quality, cost competitiveness, and customer value. The ideal candidate combines deep mechanical design expertise with strong innovation, project leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills. This role will act as a catalyst for continuous improvement, transforming field feedback, quality concerns, operational challenges, and new technology opportunities into tangible product enhancements.

  

**Product Improvement Leadership**

* Lead and drive Product Improvement Cell with end-to-end ownership of strategic improvement initiatives.
* Develop and maintain a structured pipeline of product improvement opportunities based on customer feedback, field issues, workshop observations, testing results, quality data, value engineering inputs, and technological advancements.
* Identify opportunities to improve product reliability, performance, manufacturability, maintainability, safety, and lifecycle cost.
* Drive standardization and modularization initiatives to improve engineering efficiency and reduce complexity.
* Generate innovative concepts for product enhancement and next-generation solutions.
* Lead feasibility studies, concept evaluations, technical risk assessments, business cases, and project charters.
* Prepare and present improvement proposals to Engineering Steering Committees and management forums.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, materials, manufacturing methods, and digital solutions for application in compressor products and components.

  

**Engineering Design Excellence**

* Review and validate designs, assemblies, part drawings, and design modifications for technical robustness.
* Lead design reviews and challenge existing design practices to achieve superior engineering solutions.
* Ensure compliance with relevant international standards including ASME, API, ASTM, ISO, NACE, PED, and customer specifications.
* Support critical engineering decisions through calculations, simulations, testing, and root cause investigations.
* Lead complex technical investigations arising from field failures, quality issues, and operational challenges.
* Drive Root Cause Analysis using structured methodologies such as 8D, Why-Why Analysis, FMEA, Fault Tree Analysis, and Design Reviews.
* Establish preventive and corrective actions to eliminate recurrence.
* Capture and institutionalize lessons learned into engineering standards and design guidelines.

  

**Project Management**

* Lead multiple improvement projects from ideation through implementation and benefit realization.
* Define project scope, timelines, milestones, risk mitigation plans, stakeholder responsibilities, and success criteria.
* Track project progress and ensure on time delivery of measurable business benefits.

  

**Digitalization & Engineering Productivity**

* Lead engineering automation and digital transformation initiatives.
* Improve engineering productivity through advanced use of Power BI, SAP, Teamcenter, NX, VBA, AI-enabled solutions, and other digital tools.
* Identify opportunities to eliminate manual effort, reduce engineering lead times, and improve data-driven decision-making.

  

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor a team of mechanical engineers.
* Allocate work, review deliverables, and ensure technical excellence.
* Develop team competencies, innovation mindset, and continuous improvement culture.
* Coach engineers in problem-solving, design excellence, and project execution.
* Facilitate alignment among stakeholders and drive implementation of approved improvements.
* Build strong relationships with internal and external experts to accelerate innovation and problem solving.

  

**Education, Experience and Languages:**

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Mechanical Engineering.
* Master’s Degree (M.Tech./ M.E.) from a reputed institute is preferred.
* 10+ years of industrial experience preferably in rotating equipment.
* Proven experience leading product improvement, value engineering, cost optimization, design enhancement, and cross-functional engineering initiatives.
* Proficiency in English language and knowledge of German language will be an added advantage.

  

Burckhardt Compression creates leading compression solutions for a sustainable energy future and the long-term success of its customers. The Group is the only global manufacturer that covers a full range of reciprocating compressor technologies and services. Since 1844, its passionate, customer-oriented and solution-driven workforce has set the benchmark in the gas compression industry.

title: Lead IT Service Engineer
description:

Lead day-to-day Service Desk operations as the senior technical escalation point for IT Services, ensuring consistent, secure, and high-quality support across identity, Microsoft 365, Windows and macOS endpoints, collaboration services, and the employee lifecycle. * Experience with automation platforms and scripting, such as Okta Workflows, FreshService Workflow Automator, Power Automate, PowerShell, or Bash.

* Experience managing vendors, IT asset inventory, and technology procurement.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform root cause analysis, interpret service data and trends, and translate findings into practical, lasting improvements.
* Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities under pressure.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with Okta Workflows and AI-enabled service desk tools.

BE/B.Tech/BCA/MCA or B.Sc., preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

description:
