Role Purpose
  
  
You will be a member of a new Azure squad, building an enterprise Azure platform as reusable, versioned products: landing zones, Terraform modules, policy baselines, standard images and CI/CD pipelines, all consumed through a self-service developer portal. As a senior engineer you will own significant components end to end and help set the squad's standards from day one.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Platform engineering: Design and build Azure landing zone components — subscription vending, networking, identity integration, policy baselines and guardrails — as reusable Terraform modules.
* Component ownership: Own significant platform products end-to-end: design, build, test, documentation and release management.
* CI/CD pipelines: Build and maintain GitHub Actions pipelines for infrastructure delivery, with security scanning, policy checks, testing and cost controls embedded as quality gates.
* Azure Local and hybrid: Contribute to the engineering of Azure Local capability and hybrid automation, extending the platform model into the client's private cloud estate.
* Standard images: Build and maintain pipelines for hardened compute standard images (build, test, publication).
* Self-service products: Package platform capabilities for consumption as self-service golden paths through the Port.io developer portal catalogue.
* Engineering standards: Help establish squad conventions — code review discipline, module structure, testing standards and documentation — and uphold them through peer review.
* Mentoring: Support and coach the squad's mid-level engineers; contribute to design discussions with the Engineering Lead and Platform Architect.

Essential
  

* 10+ years: in infrastructure, cloud or DevOps engineering, of which 8+ years hands-on Azure engineering.
* Azure platform depth: Strong experience with enterprise Azure — management groups, subscription design, Azure Policy, networking (hub-spoke or vWAN), Entra ID and security baselines.
* Terraform: Advanced, production Terraform experience: writing reusable modules, managing state, versioning and testing infrastructure code.
* Secure platform engineering: Building secure-by-default infrastructure as a standard part of module design: identity and least-privilege design, guardrails and policy enforcement, and secrets management.
* Testing infrastructure code: Validating infrastructure code properly, through module testing, plan review discipline and pre-merge automated checks.
* Engineering discipline: Strong Git workflow, code review and documentation habits; experience working in sprint-based agile teams.
* Collaboration: Comfortable working in a distributed team with UK-based technical leadership and client stakeholders; clear written and spoken English.

Nice to Have
  

* CI/CD platform: GitHub Actions preferred. Azure DevOps or GitLab CI transfer directly.
* Hybrid: Azure Local, Azure Stack HCI or Azure Arc.
* Security tooling: Policy-as-code (OPA, Sentinel), IaC scanning (Checkov, Wiz, tfsec), and Terratest or similar module testing frameworks.
* Scripting in Python, PowerShell or Bash for automation tooling.
* Experience in financial services or similarly regulated environments.
* Microsoft certifications (AZ-104 Azure Administrator, AZ-305 Azure Solutions Architect, AZ-400 DevOps Engineer).

Technologies Tools
  
  
**The squad's toolchain:**  

* Core: Azure, Azure Local (Azure Stack HCI), Azure Arc, Terraform, GitHub and GitHub Actions.
* Policy and security: Azure Policy, Wiz and Checkov for IaC scanning, and OPA for policy-as-code.
* Pipeline quality: tflint, terraform-docs, Infracost and Terratest.
* Consumption: The Port.io internal developer portal, which is how teams consume platform products.
* Standard images: Image pipelines for hardened compute images.

OpenGov is seeking a Product Engineer to own key foundational areas of our Public Service Platform, leading cross-functional efforts, executing discovery, and driving delivery from spec through launch. These service areas include our Identity and Access Management capabilities, powering secure access for government users, public users, and internal staff. This is the career-level role: someone who operates independently, communicates proactively, and takes clear accountability for product outcomes while leveraging AI-native tooling for execution.

**How AI Works in This Role**
-----------------------------

AI-native tooling handles a significant portion of what product managers and UX designers have historically spent their time on. That time is yours to redirect toward higher-leverage work. Specifically:

* **Spec writing:** AI drafts the first spec from your intent statement. You review, sharpen, and own what gets built.
* **UX design:** AI generates mockups from the design system based on your flow definitions. Experience Architects maintain the system itself. You make the product decisions within it.
* **Shipping code:** AI helps you ship features alongside engineering counterparts, this is no longer a handoff but now a process where everyone ships.
* **Research synthesis:** AI clusters and themes interview notes, call transcripts, and support data. You interpret what it means for the roadmap and make the call.
* **Release content:** AI generates release notes, in-app announcements, and enablement materials from your shipped features.
* **Code review:** Automated review catches style, security, and regression issues. You stay accountable for quality outcomes — not the review queue.
* **Test coverage:** AI generates test cases from the acceptance criteria you write. Your job is to write criteria that are precise enough to verify.
* **Competitive intelligence:** AI monitors competitor moves and surfaces market signals. You form the point of view and decide what it means for your roadmap.

*What AI does not do: understand your customers, make the call on what matters, own the outcome, or build the cross-functional trust that makes things ship. That is the job.*

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* Define and communicate the product vision for your area - grounded in customer research, competitive context, and business goals; not inherited from a committee.
* Conduct and synthesize customer discovery: translate what you hear into clear, defensible decisions about what to build and what to cut.
* Own the product roadmap: prioritize ruthlessly, explain your reasoning publicly, and revise it when new facts warrant it.
* Shipping code to production: you have the agency to ship code all the way to production, not just creating prototypes.
* Define user experience flows and interaction patterns within the design system; escalate to Experience Architects when genuinely new system-level patterns are required.
* Write clear intent documents that AI tooling can execute against; review and own AI-generated specs for accuracy, completeness, and correctness.
* Partner with engineering to unblock builds, resolve ambiguity in real time, and make decisions during the development cycle without becoming a bottleneck.
* Track adoption, usage, and business outcome metrics; use them to drive the next iteration, not just to report status.
* Represent your product in customer conversations, QBRs, and cross-functional reviews — the full commercial picture, not just the feature set.
* Identify gaps in AI harnesses and design system coverage; surface them as platform investment requests with clear business justification.

**Qualifications & Preferred Experience**
-----------------------------------------

* 4–6 years of experience in product management, UX design, or a closely adjacent role, with a demonstrated track record of shipping products customers use.
* Demonstrated experience building and implementing Access Control systems at scale, including working with internal stakeholders to onboard new products.
* Ability to conduct and synthesize customer discovery and translate findings into prioritized roadmap decisions.
* Proactively identifies challenges and communicates issues early; strong written and verbal skills.
* Connects different functional areas and understands their interdependencies within the broader organization.
* Comfortable defining user experience flows and working within a design system.
* Proficient or actively developing proficiency in AI-native workflows.
* SaaS product experience required; B2G background welcome.

**Why OpenGov?**
================

**A Mission That Matters.**

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

**Opportunity to Innovate**

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.

**A Place to Make Your Mark**

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

**Benefits That Work for You**

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Delivery Manager-Test Lead
description:
Job Description

**Job purpose**

Looking for a Test Lead / Data QA Engineer to drive and oversee data validation, manual testing, and regression testing activities across capital markets data pipelines spanning both legacy and modern platforms. The role is responsible for ensuring data accuracy, completeness, consistency, integrity, and adherence to business rules through source-to-target validation, schema verification, data reconciliation, lineage analysis, and automation-led regression testing.

The ideal candidate combines strong data QA and testing expertise, hands-on automation skills, capital markets domain knowledge, and a proactive ownership mindset to ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across environments.

The successful candidate will lead test delivery, manage and coordinate offshore QA resources, and engage closely with business and technology stakeholders to maintain high-quality data across post-trade and enterprise data ecosystems. Key responsibilities include building reusable Python- and SQL-based validation frameworks, supporting batch and cloud-based execution models, identifying data anomalies, validating end-to-end data flows, and embedding robust data quality controls throughout the development lifecycle.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end test planning, execution, and delivery for data validation and regression testing initiatives, ensuring quality, schedule, and stakeholder expectations are met.

* Manage and mentor offshore/onshore QA teams, including resource planning, task allocation, deliverable reviews, and adherence to testing best practices.

* Drive test governance, including test strategy, defect management, risk tracking, quality metrics, status reporting, and release readiness assessments.

* Collaborate with business, engineering, and product teams to define requirements, resolve issues, ensure test coverage, and embed quality controls across the delivery lifecycle.

* Perform source-to-target data validation across legacy and modern systems, including SQL Server and cloud-based data environments.

* Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, duplication handling, referential integrity, schema structures, metadata, lineage, and business-rule conformance.

* Build and maintain automation-first regression testing frameworks using Python, PySpark, SQL, and reusable validation utilities.

* Execute field-level, dataset-level, transformation-level, and aggregate-level data checks across source, staging, warehouse, data lake, and downstream systems.

* Validate ETL/ELT pipelines, post-trade data flows, stored procedures, batch jobs, and cloud-based execution workflows.

* Design reusable test cases, validation scenarios, reconciliation checks, automated scripts, and regression packs for repeatable data-quality assurance.

* Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries and stored procedures across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar platforms.

* Translate business rules, stored procedure logic, and post-trade process flows into automated validation scripts and assertions.

* Build Python-based utilities, APIs, CLI tools, and reusable frameworks to support data validation, orchestration, API integrations, and reporting workflows.

* Integrate regression tests, data validation checks, SQL deployables, and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, or equivalent tools.

* Automate execution of AutoSys jobs, batch processes, stored procedures, and validation scripts across development, UAT, and production environments.

* Work with engineering teams to embed data quality controls into pipelines, releases, and operational workflows.

* Identify data anomalies, schema mismatches, duplicate records, null-handling issues, transformation failures, reconciliation breaks, and integrity violations.

* Log defects with clear evidence, impact analysis, root-cause observations, and business context.

* Support capital markets and post-trade validation across allocations, clearing, settlement, confirmations, reconciliations, market data, reference data, and downstream reporting.

**Key competencies**

* 8–12 years of hands-on experience in Data QA, Data Engineering QA, or Python-based automation roles and proven experience leading QA teams, test planning, estimation, execution, defect management, and end-to-end test delivery across complex data programs.

* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate test status, risks, quality metrics, and release readiness to business and technology leadership.

* Experience establishing test strategies, governance frameworks, quality standards, resource planning, and mentoring distributed QA teams.

* Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional collaboration, manage competing priorities, mitigate delivery risks, and ensure

successful project outcomes in Agile environments.

* Strong Python skills for data validation, automation framework development, regression testing, and pipeline verification.

* Working knowledge of PySpark for validating large-scale data pipelines and distributed datasets.

* Solid SQL skills for source-to-target validation, reconciliation, complex queries, stored procedures, schema checks, and defect analysis.

* Experience in data QA, ETL/ELT testing, data pipeline testing, and regression testing across legacy and modern platforms.

* Proven experience building automation-first regression frameworks, reusable validation scripts, test cases, and data verification utilities.

* Strong understanding of data quality dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, referential integrity, and business-rule conformance.

* Experience validating metadata, schema structures, data types, constraints, lineage, transformation logic, and downstream outputs.

* Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitLab, with the ability to integrate automated tests and quality gates into deployment pipelines.

* Familiarity with batch orchestration tools such as AutoSys, Control-M, or Airflow.

* Good analytical skills to understand post-trade, financial, market data, or reference data and translate them into repeatable validation scenarios.

* Experience with JIRA, XRay, agile delivery practices, defect management, and QA process governance.

* Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot to accelerate test case generation, SQL development, data validation, defect analysis, documentation, and test data creation.

* Strong communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Domain Experience (Must Have)

* Strong experience in Fixed Income Capital Markets domain

* Good understanding of Fixed Income products, reference data, pricing, securities, positions, settlements, and trade lifecycle concepts

* Experience working with market data, reference data, and regulatory reporting-related data sets

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to Azure, AWS, ADF, containers, Kubernetes, or cloud-based data platforms.

* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar platforms.

* Exposure to Hadoop, Spark, Databricks, cloud data lakes, and Big Data validation.

* Experience validating batch, streaming, real-time, and Kafka-based ingestion pipelines.

* Capital markets domain exposure, especially post-trade, market data, reference data, trade data, or ION/blotter platform

integrations.

* Exposure to DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, and code quality tools such as Terraform, Bicep, Sonar, Mend, or ZAP.

* Act as a trusted technical advisor in customer workshops, translating business requirements into robust technical architectures.
* Mentor engineering teams on Databricks, Spark, cloud architecture, and modern AI/RAG engineering practices.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

13+ years of experience in Data Engineering / Data Architecture, with strong hands-on experience across Databricks, Hadoop, Spark/PySpark, and cloud data platforms.

* **Databricks**
  + Strong expertise in Databricks Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, and Unity Catalog.
  + Hands-on experience with Jobs/Workflows, performance optimization, and production deployments.
* **Hadoop & Spark**
  + Strong knowledge of the Hadoop ecosystem, HDFS, and Hive.
  + Strong hands-on experience with Apache Spark and PySpark for large-scale distributed data processi
* **Python**
  + Strong proficiency in Python for building scalable, reusable, production-grade data pipelines and frameworks.
  + Cloud
  + Strong experience with AWS and/or Azure, including cloud storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring.
  + Experience integrating Databricks with cloud-native services.
* **Data Engineering**
  + Expertise in ETL/ELT, batch and streaming processing, data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data quality.
  + Proven ability to design scalable, production-ready pipeline architectures.
* **SQL & Data Modelling**
  + Strong SQL skills, with experience in dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension models, SCD, and analytical data models.
* **Agentic AI**
  + Hands-on experience designing and building Agentic AI solutions with Databricks, including LLMs, tool/function calling, agent workflows, guardrails, and enterprise data integration.
* **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)**
  + Strong experience building RAG solutions using Databricks, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation.
* **Git & CI/CD**
  + Strong knowledge of Git, branching strategies, pull requests, and code reviews.
  + Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment across multiple environments.
  + Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles and/or Terraform is a plus.
* **Strategic RFPs & Solutioning**
  + Ability to participate in strategic RFP/RFI responses, solution shaping, technical proposals, and effort estimations.
  + Experience delivering architecture presentations and leading customer workshops.
* **Client Communication**
* Strong client-facing and communication skills, with the ability to understand business requirements, translate them into scalable technical solutions, and clearly communicate architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

  

* Prior experience in a consulting, systems integrator, or client-facing delivery role.
* Relevant cloud or Databricks certifications (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer / Solutions Architect, AWS/Azure certifications).
* Exposure to enterprise data governance, MLOps, or LLMOps practices.

**What working at EY offers**

  

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manager, Application Security
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Summary:**
------------

OpenGov is seeking an experienced Manager of Application Security to lead our growing AppSec team. This role blends technical expertise with people leadership, driving a secure-by-design culture across our engineering organization while mentoring and empowering a high-performing team.

You will oversee the strategy and execution of application security initiatives, embedding industry-leading standards such as OWASP into our development lifecycle. The ideal candidate is collaborative, approachable, and an excellent communicator, capable of building trust with engineers, product leaders, and executives alike.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Lead and mentor the Application Security team to drive engagement, growth, and technical excellence.
* Build and execute the organization’s application security roadmap to strengthen the security posture of all product suites and APIs.
* Champion secure development practices by embedding OWASP ASVS and OWASP Top 10 guidance into coding standards, architecture reviews, and threat modeling.
* Oversee the selection, deployment, and integration of AppSec tools (e.g., SAST, DAST, SCA, ASPM) into CI/CD pipelines.
* Partner with Engineering, DevOps, and Product to ensure secure coding, design reviews, and vulnerability management processes are followed.
* Report on risk metrics, remediation progress, and program effectiveness to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and fun team culture that inspires innovation and continuous improvement.
* Serve as the AppSec subject-matter expert for internal audits, customer reviews, and compliance (SOC 2, GovRAMP, FedRAMP, etc.).

**Required Qualifications:**
----------------------------

* 7+ years of combined experience in Application Security, Software Engineering, or related fields; 3+ years leading or managing security teams.
* Deep understanding of OWASP ASVS, OWASP Top 10, and secure software development practices.
* Hands-on experience with modern AppSec tools and frameworks (SAST, DAST, SCA, API security, ASPM).
* Proven ability to build and motivate high-performing teams, with strong mentoring and coaching skills.
* Excellent communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management abilities.
* Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to influence across technical and non-technical teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* MA/MS in a technology related discipline
* Experience in a SaaS or cloud-native software company.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and security automation.
* Knowledge of compliance and regulatory frameworks relevant to software companies (SOC 2, GovRAMP, FedRAMP, etc.).
* Certifications such as CSSLP, CISSP, OSWE, or similar AppSec credentials.

**Why OpenGov?**
================

**A Mission That Matters.**

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

**Opportunity to Innovate**

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.

**A Place to Make Your Mark**

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

**Benefits That Work for You**

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

**Role Description:**

As an AVP and Senior GCP Data and AI Engineer, you will lead the architecture and hands\-on delivery of complex data and generative AI solutions on GCP. * Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above  
*

* Design, build, and operationalize sophisticated AI applications, including production\-grade **RAG pipelines** on GCP.
* Leverage the **Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform** to train, fine\-tune, and deploy machine learning and generative AI models.
* Design and implement complex **agentic workflows** to automate and optimize business processes.
* Design, develop, integrate, secure, version, test, deploy, consume, and operate mission\-critical **REST APIs** using Python, with containerised deployment on **Cloud Run** .

Automate data quality and ETL testing procedures using Python and SQL.  
*

* Own security and governance controls for data and AI solutions, including IAM, least\-privilege access, encryption, secrets management, audit logging, data protection, and compliance with enterprise standards.

Serve as a key escalation point for complex L3 production issues, providing expert troubleshooting and resolution.  

* 

  

**Your skills and experience**

  

**Mandatory Engineering Skills:**

* **6\-10 years of IT experience** as a hands\-on engineer, including responsibility for designing, building, deploying, and supporting large\-scale data systems in production.
* **Expert\-Level Languages:** Deep proficiency in **Python** and advanced **SQL** , including complex query optimization and data modelling.
* **Cloud Platform:** Extensive hands\-on experience building solutions on **GCP** . Experience with Azure or AWS is also valuable.

* **Infrastructure \& Automation:** Proficient in defining infrastructure as code using **Terraform** and designing and managing robust CI/CD pipelines using **Cloud Build** , **Artifact Registry** , automated testing, vulnerability scanning, and environment\-based release strategies.

  

**Advanced Technical \& Design Expertise:** We expect candidates to have deep, practical experience in the following areas, with a portfolio of projects demonstrating their expertise.


* **System Design:** Strong understanding of modern **data patterns** , distributed systems, and architectural best practices.
* **Conversational AI:** Hands\-on experience designing and developing conversational AI solutions and chatbots using **Dialog flow CX (Conversational Agents)** or **CX Agent Studio** .
* **Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform:** Extensive hands\-on experience building enterprise AI solutions using the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, including agent configuration, integration, evaluation, security, deployment, and operational monitoring.
* **Generative AI Systems:** Proven experience building and deploying production\-grade **RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation)** systems. Deep understanding of LLMs (like Gemini), **vector databases** , and embedding models.
* **Agentic AI Application \& Workflow Development:** Strong practical experience designing and developing agentic AI applications, complex workflows, agentic patterns, and multi\-agent systems using the **Google Agent Development Kit (ADK)** . Knowledge of concepts such as the **A2A (agent\-to\-agent) protocol** and **agent cards** is highly desirable.
* **AgentOps \& Application Hosting:** Demonstrable experience in operationalizing AI models and hosting applications using containers (Docker).

* Coaching and support from experts in your team

**ROLE SUMMARY**


The Global Financial Reporting function is investing in AI and intelligent automation to modernize how financial data is produced, reviewed, and reported. We are looking for a hands\-on Prompt Engineer to design, build and optimize the prompts, workflows and AI\-driven solutions that power this transformation.


This is a practical, delivery\-focused role for someone who genuinely understands how Large Language Models (LLMs) work and can turn business problems into reliable, production\-ready AI solutions. The successful candidate will combine deep prompt\-engineering expertise with strong Excel/VBA Macro skills, translating complex reporting and reconciliation tasks into automated, auditable outputs. Experience within Banking and Financial Services (BFS) is a strong advantage, given the regulatory and data\-sensitivity of our environment.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1\. Prompt Engineering \& AI Solution Design**

* Design, test and iterate high\-quality prompts for LLMs to support financial reporting, analysis, summarization and data extraction use cases.
* Apply advanced prompting techniques (few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought, structured output, retrieval\-augmented generation) to improve accuracy, consistency and reliability.
* Build reusable prompt libraries, templates and guardrails that can be adopted across the Financial Reporting function.
* Evaluate model output systematically, reduce hallucinations, and tune solutions for factual, audit\-ready results.

**2\. Automation \& Macro Development**

* Develop and maintain Excel Macros (VBA) to automate recurring reporting, reconciliation and data\-manipulation tasks.
* Integrate AI capabilities with spreadsheet\-based and existing finance tooling to create end\-to\-end automated workflows.
* Reduce manual effort and turnaround time by standardizing and automating repetitive reporting processes.

**3\. Delivery, Testing \& Governance**

* Own solutions from concept to production, including documentation, version control, testing and handover.
* Ensure all AI and automation outputs are accurate, explainable, and compliant with data protection and internal control requirements.
* Maintain clear audit trails and adhere to security, privacy and governance standards appropriate to a regulated BFS environment.

**4\. Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement**

* Work closely with Financial Reporting, Data and Technology teams to identify and prioritise high\-value AI use cases.
* Translate business requirements into clear technical specifications and practical solutions.
* Stay current with developments in AI, prompt engineering and automation, and proactively recommend improvements.

**SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE REQUIRED**

**Essential**

* Proven, hands\-on experience as a Prompt Engineer (or equivalent) working directly with LLMs such as GPT, Claude or similar.
* Deep, practical understanding of how AI/LLMs work, including prompt design, tuning, and evaluation of outputs.
* Strong Excel Macro / VBA skills, with a demonstrable track record of building automation for data\-heavy processes.
* Ability to work independently, deliver production\-ready solutions, and clearly document and explain your work.
* Strong analytical mindset with high attention to accuracy and detail.

**Desirable**

* Experience within the Banking and Financial Services (BFS) industry, ideally in a reporting, finance or data function.
* Exposure to Python or other scripting for AI integration and automation.
* Familiarity with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), APIs, and AI platforms/tooling.
* Understanding of financial reporting concepts, data controls, and regulatory/audit requirements.

**BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES**

* Hands\-on, delivery\-focused and comfortable owning solutions end\-to\-end.
* Curious and continuously learning, with genuine passion for AI and automation.
* Clear communicator who can explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Detail\-oriented, dependable, and mindful of accuracy in a regulated environment.

**LOCATION**

**This is a fully on\-site role based in Pune West, Maharashtra, India.** Candidates must be able to work on\-site five days a week. This position is not available on a remote or hybrid basis.

**ABOUT APEX GROUP**


Apex Group, established in Bermuda in 2003, is a leading global financial services provider. Operating in 52 countries with 100\+ offices and over 13,000 professionals, Apex services more than $3\.5 trillion in assets worldwide. The Group delivers a single\-source solution across the entire value chain, including fund administration, financial solutions, corporate services, capital raising and digital asset support, all underpinned by innovative technology and cross\-jurisdictional expertise.

*Apex is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all colleagues.*


Disclaimer: Unsolicited CVs sent to Apex (Talent Acquisition Team or Hiring Managers) by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this position. Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.

**Business Title: Engineering Manager**  

This role is based in Pune. This location works on a hybrid model, **2\-3 days in the office** . You will be required to interview in person.  



  

**About SailPoint**  

SailPoint is defining the next era of identity security. Our unified, AI\-powered platform seamlessly secures both the Human Fabric of your workforce and the Agentic Fabric of AI and non\-human identities, completely eliminating organizational blind spots.
  

Built on core principles like zero\-standing privilege and contextualized risk, our platform transforms identity from a vulnerability into a strategic business advantage. Today, we are trusted by some of the largest, most complex organizations in the world to deliver intelligent, autonomous identity security at scale.
  

  

**About the Role**  

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead and empower a high\-performing team of software engineers responsible for owning the technical development of SailPoint’s core product capabilities. In this role, you will champion technical excellence, write and review quality code, debug complex distributed systems issues, and foster a culture of innovation and continuous delivery. You will work in an Agile environment, collaborating closely with US\-based teams and stakeholders to build and maintain cloud\-native, event\-driven microservices on AWS.
  

  

**About the Team**  

At SailPoint, our Engineering team is where high\-quality professional engineering meets individual impact. We are a results\-driven crew built on innovation, collaboration, and mutual trust. Our team designs and deploys scalable, enterprise\-grade identity security products powered by mature cloud architecture and cutting\-edge technologies.
  

  

**Requirements**

* Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience

* Strong foundational understanding of **software development, particularly in Java,** as well as modern front\-end architectures.
* Proven track record of success delivering complex software solutions in an Agile development environment
* Solid foundation in software engineering principles, distributed systems, and cloud architecture (AWS preferred)
* Exceptional leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills with a passion for continuous improvement
* Strong project management abilities with experience scoping, prioritizing, tracking, and delivering engineering milestones
* Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across global time zones
Willingness to maintain at least 4 overlapping working hours with US time zones  
* 

  

**AI\-assisted engineering:**  

Our engineers are expected to use AI development tools as a core part of their daily workflow, not as a novelty. We expect you to use these tools to accelerate delivery, expand your scope, and raise the quality bar, while applying strong engineering judgment to review, validate, and own everything that ships under your name. Comfort with prompting, agentic workflows, and human\-in\-the\-loop review of AI\-generated code is a baseline expectation for this role.
  

  

**AI related Technology:**

* Cursor, Claude Code
* Python\-based AI/ML frameworks and libraries such as scikit\-learn, pandas, and numpy
* Deep Learning Frameworks such as PyTorch
LLMs and Foundation Models in Bedrock, VertexAI, or similar  
* 

  

**Roadmap for Success**

  

**30 Days:**

* Complete SailPoint onboarding, understand our identity security product suite, and get familiar with the cloud\-native, event\-driven microservices architecture hosted on AWS.
* Establish relationships with your engineering team, Product Management partners, and US\-based counterparts.
* Understand the current sprint commitments, team workflows, and active technical priorities.

**60 Days:**

* Assume day\-to\-day leadership of the engineering team and run Agile ceremonies effectively.
* Actively partner with Product Management to review roadmaps, scope incoming projects, and allocate engineering resources.
* Begin coaching and setting clear performance objectives for direct reports through regular 1:1 mentorship sessions.

**90 Days:**

* Own end\-to\-end project planning, tracking, and risk management for your team's deliverables and key milestones.
* Maintain a seamless communication cadence with global stakeholders, ensuring overlapping collaboration with the US team.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement process or architectural improvements to raise code quality and team velocity.

**6 Months:**

* Drive the successful release of high\-impact features and architectural enhancements to production on AWS.
* Foster a strong culture of career development, mentoring engineers toward their next career milestones.
* Proactively manage technical risk, system reliability, and resource allocation across multiple simultaneous initiatives.

**1 Year:**

* Establish a proven track record of predictable, high\-quality product delivery that advances SailPoint’s identity security platform.
Scale team capabilities, mentor emerging leaders, and contribute strategic engineering input toward long\-term product roadmaps.  
*

description:

As Engineer I \- End User Technology Operations at Accelya, you will support end\-user computing operations, device lifecycle management and IT service desk support activities, maintaining infrastructure services and contributing to the reliability and security of our enterprise IT environment across 10 global offices.  

  

Duties \& Responsibilities

* Participate in on\-call rotation and support escalation or equivalent processes as required

  

Required Experience \& Skills  

* 2 years of experience in End User Technology Operations or a closely related IT infrastructure role
* Good foundational knowledge of Microsoft Intune, Azure AD/Entra ID, ServiceNow ITSM, remote support tools and ITIL\-aligned IT service desk operations
* Understanding of ITIL service management principles and incident/change management processes
* Strong problem\-solving, documentation and communication skills
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or a related field; relevant entry\-level certifications preferred

  

Preferred Experience \& Skills  

* Experience using ServiceNow AI or equivalent, Microsoft Copilot and Claude/ChatGPT or equivalent for AI\-powered IT service desk automation, intelligent incident resolution and self\-service IT support for AI\-assisted infrastructure management, documentation and incident investigation

What do we offer?  

* An open culture with a creative and challenging opportunity to satisfy your intellectual needs
* Flexible working hours
* Smart working: a hybrid remote/office working environment
* Work\-life balance
* An excellent, dynamic and multicultural environment to work in

  

About Accelya  

Accelya is a leading global software provider to the airline industry, powering over 200 airlines with an open, modular software platform. Owned by Vista Equity Partners, we bring together 2,000\+ employees across 10 global offices. We are proud partners of AWS and pioneers in NDC expertise. Find out more at www.accelya.com

Our team is very hands\-on with a strong mindset of problem\-solving while also having the ability to think holistically and provide solutions that solve the customer's long\-term challenges. **ROLE**:



We are seeking a highly technical, hands‑on, and detail‑oriented Principal Integration professional to lead the **most complex, hands‑on integration designs and builds** across our implementation portfolio. The ideal candidate is a senior individual contributor with a strong integration background and a proven track record of designing, implementing, and optimizing mission‑critical interfaces between cloud platforms and enterprise systems.



You will act as the go‑to integration expert across projects: owning design, build, troubleshooting and optimization for the most critical and technically ambiguous data flows, while setting standards that Senior Integration Leads and project teams execute against, and mentoring other team members (without direct line management).



This role is an individual contributor position, with significant autonomy and impact.


**WHAT YOU WILL DO WITH US**


**Integration Design \& Implementation**


* *End‑to‑End Integration Design:* Lead the detailed design of the most complex integrations between Ivalua and ERPs, HR, finance, logistics, and other third‑party systems, ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.

* *Standards \& Reuse:* Define, publish, and continuously refine integration standards, reusable patterns, and best practices (e.g., modular mappings, error handling, logging, versioning) for Senior Integration Leads and consultants to apply across projects.
* *Performance \& Robustness:* Analyze and optimize integration performance (throughput, latency, data volumes), and design robust error handling, reconciliation and recovery strategies that serve as the reference approach for the broader team.
* *Troubleshooting \& Debugging:* Act as the top‑level technical escalation point for integration‑related incidents that Senior Integration Leads and project teams cannot resolve, during build, SIT/UAT, go‑live and hypercare phases.


**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

\#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

**About this role**
-------------------



We are seeking a skilled Senior Billing Operations Support Engineer to provide hands\-on L2 Application Operations support across telecom billing platforms. This role focuses on ensuring reliable bill\-cycle execution, invoice processing, call/CDR processing, discrepancy management and operational excellence within a production environment. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining service availability, restoring incidents, improving observability, driving automation and supporting billing accuracy through proactive monitoring, validation and reconciliation activities. This opportunity is based in Pune and is suited to individuals with strong Telecom IT, BSS or enterprise billing operations experience and a passion for continual service improvement.

**What you will do**
--------------------



Billing Operations \& Bill Run Processing  

* Own the day\-to\-day operational health and technical support of billing processes within the assigned service scope.
* Execute and monitor pre\-bill checks, bill preparation, bill production, bill generation, customer notifications and bill\-cycle closure activities.
* Troubleshoot bill\-run failures, rejected accounts, long\-running jobs, database constraints, capacity limitations, scheduler issues and billing exceptions.
* Perform post\-bill validation, billed\-account verification, amount reconciliations and exception management to ensure accurate cycle closure.


Invoice Posting \& Downstream Processing  

* Monitor invoice generation, validation, posting, extraction and downstream delivery processes.
* Investigate invoice rejections, posting failures, missing outputs, balance mismatches and invoice data issues.
* Coordinate operational recovery and issue resolution within agreed service targets.


Call / CDR Processing  

* Monitor call, event and CDR processing, rating and re\-rating activities.
* Manage suspended or rejected records, processing backlogs and delayed usage affecting billing cycles.
* Troubleshoot processing\-chain issues, validation failures, sequencing challenges, capacity concerns and data\-quality exceptions.


Discrepancy Management \& Billing Assurance  

* Analyse discrepancies across customer, product, pricing, discount, billing profile, usage, invoice, payment and accounts receivable data.
* Conduct or coordinate reconciliations across CRM, mediation, billing, invoicing and downstream platforms.
* Track exceptions through to resolution and identify recurring patterns that may impact billing accuracy or revenue assurance.


Incident, Problem, SLA \& Service Management  

* Lead L2 incident triage and service restoration activities for billing\-related incidents.
* Escalate complex issues to L3 support teams or vendors where required.
* Perform root cause analysis, maintain known\-error records and implement corrective actions.
* Monitor SLA and KPI performance, operational risks, incident ageing and backlog trends.


Automation, AI \& Continual Improvement  

* Automate recurring operational activities including reconciliations, health checks, monitoring, reporting and validations using Shell scripting, SQL and approved automation tools.
* Enhance dashboards, observability solutions and proactive alerting capabilities.
* Leverage approved AI and AIOps capabilities for anomaly detection, event correlation, knowledge retrieval, incident triage and root cause analysis support.
* Contribute to continual improvement initiatives focused on operational efficiency, billing accuracy and reduced manual effort.


Operational Governance \& Knowledge Management  

* Provide operational updates covering bill\-cycle progress, incidents, service performance and improvement initiatives.
* Maintain runbooks, operational procedures, billing calendars, reconciliation controls, recovery processes and audit evidence.
**Who you are**
---------------



Essential Experience  

* 4\+ years of Telecom IT, BSS or enterprise billing Application Operations experience with strong production support responsibility.
* Demonstrated experience in bill run processing, invoice posting and processing, call/CDR processing and billing discrepancy management.
* Experience analysing billing failures, processing backlogs, invoice exceptions and reconciliation issues across multiple systems.
* Strong experience in SLA\-driven Incident, Problem, Change and Service Request management.
* Proven experience supporting priority incidents and conducting root cause analysis.


Technical Skills  

* Hands\-on experience with telecom billing platforms such as Oracle BRM, Amdocs, Kenan, Geneva/SingleView, BSCS or equivalent solutions.
* Strong Unix/Linux administration and Shell scripting expertise.
* Strong Oracle SQL and PL/SQL skills for troubleshooting, reporting, reconciliation and automation.
* Experience with batch processing, schedulers, file management, database performance analysis and log investigation.
* Understanding of interfaces across CRM, mediation, billing, invoicing, payment, reporting and document management systems.

description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.


**About the Team**

At Workday, we bring technical rigor, customer empathy, and a spirit of fun to enterprise software. Our support team underpins operational excellence across Workday's digital experience, AI/ML platform, and Agent Factory initiative—our internal engine that builds, trains, and deploys autonomous AI agents to execute complex HR and Finance workflows.
  

Within this broader ecosystem, the Workday Adaptive Planning Support team plays a critical role in empowering our customers to build agile, data\-driven financial strategies. We partner directly with core engineering, data science, and product development to eliminate bottlenecks, maintain high platform availability, and ensure system reliability across both traditional SaaS features and next\-generation AI workflows for our global customer base.
**About the Role**

We are seeking a customer\-focused **Support Engineer** who is excited about supporting AI/ML/ SaaS functionality and platforms and passionate about helping customers solve complex problems. In this **high\-visibility, customer\-facing role** , you will manage a ticket queue of cases with varying complexity specifically for Adaptive Planning’s Financial and Workforce Planning products.


You will drive incident resolution, root\-cause analysis (RCA), and performance optimization across both Workday Adaptive Planning’s enterprise web applications and autonomous AI agent workflows. Partnering closely with product and support analyst teams, you will help customers find timely workarounds and solutions while managing critical escalations within strict SLAs.


A key part of this role will also involve hands\-on technical debugging and AI evaluation. You will analyze system metrics, debug cloud\-hosted ML service pipelines, inspect LLM orchestration layers, review conversation logs, and dig into system traces to spot failure modes—translating those insights into prompt, data, and workflow improvements.  



  

**Location \& Shift**
---------------------

* **Location:** **This position is based in the Workday Pune office. Candidates should be local to the Pune area or willing to relocate.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Hybrid Work:** Candidates will be expected to work from the office at least 50% of the time.
* **Hours:** Typical shift will be from 8:00 AM \- 5:00 PM IST
* **On\-Call:** Participation in an on\-call rotation is required to provide after\-hours support when needed.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Core Planning and Reporting Troubleshooting:** **Troubleshoot with customers on cases to resolve reported issues with their financial data, reporting, and/or financial integrations.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Enterprise SaaS \& Functional Domain Expertise:** Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise applications to validate AI responses and assist in troubleshooting functional processing errors.
* **Hands\-On AI Evaluation:** Review LLM outputs, conversation logs, and execution traces to identify edge cases, hallucinations, and routine failure modes. Perform structured data labeling and report findings to senior engineering staff.
* **Technical Troubleshooting \& RCA:** Assist in root\-cause analysis for software defects and pipeline execution failures using monitoring tools like Kibana and Grafana, following established diagnostic runbooks.
* **Cloud \& LLM Diagnostics:** Inspect enterprise AI workflows hosted in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP), helping isolate breakdown points across model hosting services and API gateways.
* **Incident \& Queue Management:** Monitor and triage support queues, enforce SLAs, and process incoming tickets efficiently. Support high\-severity incident responses and participate in weekend on\-call rotations.
* **Customer Communication:** Communicate clear technical updates, standard workarounds, and resolution steps to customer IT teams, working with senior support for high\-stakes escalations.
* **Database \& Code Diagnostics:** Write standard SQL queries to validate backend data integrity, inspect REST/SOAP API payloads (JSON/XML), and execute existing Python or Bash scripts to run routine diagnostics.
* **Documentation \& Team Collaboration:** Maintain detailed investigation logs in Jira, ServiceNow, or Salesforce, help maintain team runbooks, and flag recurring issue trends to senior engineers and product teams.

**About You**

**Basic Qualifications (Required)**
-----------------------------------

* **Work Experience:** **Minimum 1 year of experience in technical support, platform operations, or application support for enterprise SaaS environments.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Technical \& Diagnostic Skills:**
	+ Minimum 1 year of experience writing and executing intermediate SQL queries and running diagnostic scripts.
	+ Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting API payloads (JSON or XML data structures) and utilizing basic Linux or Windows command\-line tools.
* **Cloud \& Monitoring Systems:**
	+ Minimum 1 year of hands\-on experience navigating or monitoring services on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
	+ Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Datadog) to view logs or trace outputs.
* **AI \& LLM Exposure:** Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting, reading, or evaluating AI/LLM conversation logs, traces, or prompt outputs.
* **Triage \& Operations:**
	+ Minimum 1 year of experience performing initial queue triage and basic troubleshooting using ticketing workflows.
	+ Ability to manage multiple cases at once with some to no guidance around prioritization.
	Willingness and ability to work scheduled weekend and holiday coverage rotations.  
	+

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* **Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Experience following established runbooks to perform guided, autonomous technical troubleshooting.
* History of drafting clear written technical documentation, post\-incident updates, or resolution notes for customer\-facing teams.
* Strong active problem\-solving skills and an adaptability to learn complex, multi\-tiered enterprise systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, combined with the ability to communicate with users at all levels and varying technical ability.
* Experience collaborating with internal development and/or QA teams, acting as a customer advocate.
* Had previous experience or knowledge of finance and/or financial planning software applications or integrations
* Have these technical skills:
	+ ETL, tools (e.g., Pentaho) or Integration Implementation/Support
	+ Jenkins \& Git
	+ Kubernetes and Docker
	+ ELK or other log aggregation tool
	+ JavaScript

title: Escalation Manager
description:
**Company Description**  

QAD Inc. is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud\-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. Global manufacturers face ever\-increasing disruption caused by technology\-driven innovation and changing consumer preferences. In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. QAD calls these companies Adaptive Manufacturing Enterprises. QAD solutions help customers in the automotive, life sciences, packaging, consumer products, food and beverage, high tech and industrial manufacturing industries rapidly adapt to change and innovate for competitive advantage. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real\-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.

**This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune, with 3\-4 days of in\-office collaboration per week.**

 **Job Description**  

The **Escalation Manager** is a specialized individual contributor role within the Global Support organization, responsible for owning and managing critical customer account escalations from onset through stabilization and closure. This role acts as the single point of accountability within Support for escalated accounts, ensuring issues are addressed with urgency, structure, and cross\-functional alignment.


The EM’s primary objective is to stabilize high\-risk customer accounts by driving the resolution of critical issues, coordinating closely with Support, Engineering, Cloud Operations, and Product teams. This includes ensuring proper prioritization of P1 and high\-impact cases, enforcing case hygiene, facilitating timely Engineering engagement, and ensuring that internal escalation paths are triggered proactively before the customer or Sales team raises concerns externally.


This role requires strong technical depth across ERP application architecture, infrastructure, and troubleshooting. The EM must be able to understand complex technical landscapes, challenge and guide resolution strategies, and hold teams accountable for progress. While not responsible for direct implementation or relationship management, the EM acts as the technical escalation leader for the account, ensuring a coordinated and transparent support response.

**Beyond day\-to\-day escalation handling, the Escalation Manager plays a critical role in:**

* Identifying systemic or recurring issues contributing to account instability.
* Driving and participating in account\-level stabilization plans.
* Engaging in post\-escalation reviews to strengthen processes and prevent recurrence.
* Ensuring clear and structured internal and external communication.


This is a high\-visibility role requiring composure under pressure, strong cross\-functional leadership without formal authority, and the ability to influence outcomes across multiple teams. Given the nature of escalated accounts, the position may require flexible working hours, on\-call participation, and direct executive visibility.

**Escalated Account Ownership:**

* Act as the primary escalation lead for high\-impact customer accounts, ensuring structured management of escalations from initiation through stabilization and closure.
* Drive internal alignment and ensure timely execution of action plans across Support, Engineering, Cloud Ops, and Product.

**Stabilization and Resolution Strategy:**

* Develop and execute account\-level stabilization plans to address critical issues, reduce ticket volumes, and restore customer confidence.
* Proactively identify systemic issues contributing to escalations and drive resolution with the right internal stakeholders.

**Escalation Governance:**

* Ensure proper prioritization, case hygiene, and timely engagement of technical resources for all escalated accounts.
* Trigger and manage internal escalation paths proactively to avoid external escalations through CSM or Sales.
* Set customer expectations and provide updates regarding troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer\-facing communications.

**Technical Engagement and Resolution Acceleration:**

* Leverage strong technical knowledge of ERP architecture and infrastructure to guide resolution strategies and validate progress.
* Collaborate closely with Critical Support team, Tier 2/3 engineers, SMEs, and product teams to remove technical blockers and accelerate resolution timelines.

**Cross\-Functional Coordination and Communication:**

* Coordinate across Support, Engineering, Cloud Ops, Product Management, and CSM/CSDM teams to ensure alignment and accountability.
* Deliver clear, structured, and timely communications on escalation status, risks, and next steps to all stakeholders.

**Feedback Loop and Product Improvement:**

* Partner with CSM/CSDMs and Product Management to share customer feedback, recurring pain points, and systemic issues observed during escalations.
* Work with Engineering teams to help prioritize critical fixes and influence product stability and supportability improvements.

**Shift Coverage and Flexibility:**

* Participate in shift rotations, weekend shifts, and on\-call coverage to provide uninterrupted global support.
* Adapt to varying scheduling requirements to ensure timely assistance for customers in different time zones.

**Continuous Improvement and Post\-Escalation Review:**

* Lead or contribute to post\-escalation reviews to identify root causes, process gaps, and product opportunities.
* Support implementation of preventive measures to minimize future escalations and strengthen overall support readiness.
* Collaborate with people managers and business leaders to drive continuous improvement in people, processes, and technology through a closed\-loop process by identifying drivers for escalation.

 **Qualifications** **Education:**


A Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Equivalent experience will be considered.

**Experience:**

* 5\+ years of experience in enterprise product support, technical escalation management, or critical response roles in a SaaS or ERP environment.
* Demonstrated ability to own and drive critical account escalations, ensuring cross\-functional alignment and rapid resolution.
* Proven experience in working closely with Engineering, Product Management, and Customer Success teams to resolve high\-impact technical issues.
* Strong background in ERP systems (such as QAD, SAP, Oracle ERP, or Dynamics 365\) with the ability to understand complex technical landscapes and influence resolution strategies.
* Experience coordinating multiple high\-priority issues simultaneously under pressure, with clear accountability and customer focus.
* Experience leveraging AI tools (such as generative AI assistants, diagnostic copilots, or predictive analytics platforms) to analyze incident data, perform rapid root cause analysis, and identify systemic escalation patterns across ticket histories.
* Hands\-on experience using Jira Service Management and Salesforce Service Cloud to manage critical account escalations, track ticket SLA compliance, enforce case hygiene, and link Tier\-3 engineering bugs with customer\-facing cases.
* Background operating within multi\-tenant SaaS or hybrid\-cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP), managing incident workflows involving cloud infrastructure, microservices, database performance, or server deployment issues.
* Proven track record of driving rapid war\-room coordination, real\-time stakeholder updates, and post\-incident documentation.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of enterprise ERP architecture, system integrations, and infrastructure components.
* Mastery of Google Workspace (Google Docs, Sheets, Slides) for building real\-time escalation trackers, publishing root cause analysis (RCA) reports, and delivering executive\-ready presentations.
* Cloud Infrastructure \& Architecture: Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), including cloud infrastructure components, APIs, microservices, containerized environments, and log management tools (e.g., Datadog, Splunk, CloudWatch).
* Ability to understand and validate technical resolution paths proposed by Support, Engineering, or Cloud Ops teams.
* Familiarity with incident and escalation management frameworks and best practices in SaaS or on\-prem environments.
* Preferred / Bonus Qualifications: Prompt Engineering \& Generative AI Tools: Hands\-on experience utilizing Generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, MS Copilot, or custom internal LLMs) for prompt\-driven summary generation, ticket sentiment analysis, incident documentation, and automated stakeholder communication drafting.
* QAD PKS or relevant industry certifications are a plus.

 **Additional Information*** Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.

title: Support Technician
description:
Support Technician \| scanO

Company: Trismus Healthcare Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (scanO)

Location: Pune, Corporate Office

Employment Type: Full\-time, On\-site

Reports To: Head of Customer Support / Operations

Working Days: 6 days per week  
Schedule: Monday–Saturday or Sunday–Friday, based on team allocation

About scanO

scanO builds AI\-powered oral health screening solutions for dental clinics, including scanO air, our screening unit; scanO engage, our practitioner platform; and scanO care, our patient app.

Over 400 units are live across clinics in India, the UK, UAE, and South Africa. When something does not work, clinics rely on our support team. How quickly and effectively we resolve those issues directly impacts their experience with scanO.

Role Overview

We are looking for a technically strong and customer\-focused Support Technician to join our support desk.

Clinics will reach out through email, phone, and WhatsApp with issues ranging from “the scan will not start” to “this AI report looks incorrect.”

You will diagnose issues, resolve what you can remotely, escalate technical problems to the appropriate engineer or field technician, and follow through until the clinic is operational again.

You will also maintain accurate records of our installed device fleet and help convert real customer issues into actionable feedback for our product, engineering, ML, and clinical teams.

This is a technical support role, not a call centre role. You should be able to understand how the device, application, and network work together well enough to isolate and troubleshoot faults remotely.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Own the Support Queue

Respond to support requests received through support@scanoai.com, phone, and WhatsApp within defined response timelines. Log every issue, maintain accurate statuses, and close the loop with the clinic.

2\. Diagnose Issues Remotely

Troubleshoot device, application, connectivity, and user\-related issues through phone, chat, and screen sharing. Reproduce issues wherever possible before escalating them.

3\. Escalate \& Follow Through

Raise clear and reproducible bug reports for the engineering team, including logs, unit ID, firmware version, and reproduction steps. Track escalations until resolution and keep the customer informed.

4\. Coordinate Field Service

Coordinate technician visits, part replacements, and unit returns with the operations team. Track units from pickup through service and redeployment.

5\. Maintain the Fleet Record

Keep accurate records of installed units, including clinic details, unit serial numbers, firmware versions, warranty status, open faults, and service history.

6\. Report AI Output Corrections

Collect cases where clinicians dispute or correct AI\-generated reports and share them with the ML and clinical teams, along with relevant images and context.

7\. Identify Recurring Patterns

Prepare a weekly summary covering support volumes, recurring faults, and major issue drivers to help the team address root causes instead of individual symptoms.

8\. Build the Knowledge Base

Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, FAQs, and clinic\-facing how\-to documentation as the product evolves.

9\. Support the Field Team

Provide remote technical assistance during installations, camps, demos, inaugurations, and escalations.

Requirements

Diploma or degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science, or a related technical field

1–3 years of experience in technical support, service desk, field service, or device support

Strong freshers with demonstrated technical aptitude may also be considered

Comfortable troubleshooting hardware, mobile/web applications, Wi\-Fi, and basic networking

Clear spoken and written English and Hindi

Marathi or another regional language is an advantage

Ability to explain technical solutions clearly to dentists, receptionists, and other non\-technical users

Ability to remain calm and professional while handling frustrated customers

Strong discipline around issue logging, ownership, follow\-ups, and closure

Comfortable using spreadsheets and ticketing/CRM tools

Nice to Have

Experience with medical, diagnostic, or imaging devices

Familiarity with Zoho CRM/Helpdesk or similar tools

Basic understanding of computer vision or AI model outputs

Willingness to travel occasionally for installations or escalations

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid time off
